rules.text: The bearer’s unit has the SMOKE keyword and you can target it with the Smokescreen Stratagem for 0CP.

rules.name: Spotter
rules.text: The bearer’s ranged weapons have a Ballistic Skill characteristic of 3+.

rules.name: Survey Augur
rules.text: Each time the bearer’s unit has shot, select one enemy unit that was hit by one or more attacks made by the bearer this phase. Until the end of the phase, each time a friendly GENESTEALER CULTS model makes an attack against that unit, that attack has the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

rules.name: Industrialised Destruction
rules.text: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound Roll of 1. If the target of that attack is an enemy unit within range of an objective marker, you can re-roll the wound roll.

rules.name: Nexus of Devotion
rules.text: While this model is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability. If that unit has the HYBRID METAMORPHS keyword, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability instead.

rules.name: Summon the Cult
rules.text: Once per battle, when you have to remove a Cult Ambush marker because your opponent has moved too close to it, if one or more models from your army with this ability are on the battlefield, you can use this ability. If you do, instead of removing that marker, you can place it anywhere on the battlefield that is within 12" of a model from your army with this ability and more than 9" horizontally away from all enemy units (if this is not possible, this ability is not considered to have been used and that marker is removed as normal).

rules.name: Leader
rules.text:
This model can be attached to the following units:
- **^^Acolyte Hybrids^^**
- **^^Hybrid Metamorphs^^**
- **^^Neophyte Hybrids^^**

rules.name: Outrider Gangs
rules.text: Each time you use the Cult Ambush ability to set this unit back up on the battlefield, in addition to the normal rules, all of its models must be set up wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and at least one of its models must be touching one of your Cult Ambush markers (that marker is then removed from the battlefield). If this cannot be done, this unit cannot be set back up.

rules.name: Demolition Run
rules.text: Once per battle round, in your Movement phase, when this unit ends a Normal, Advance, or Fall Back move, you can select one enemy unit within 6" of and visible to this unit and roll one D6 for each ATALAN JACKALS model in this unit: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds.)

rules.name: Twisted Science
rules.text: While this model is leading a unit, melee weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

rules.name: Biological Warfare
rules.text: Once per battle, when this model’s unit is selected to fight, this model can use this ability. If it does, until the end of the phase, improve the Attacks and Damage characteristics of its injector goad by 3.

rules.name: Alchemicus Familiar
rules.text: Once per battle, when the bearer’s unit is selected to fight, the bearer can use its alchemicus familiar. If it does, until the end of the phase, each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack that targets an INFANTRY unit, add 1 to the Wound roll

rules.name: Voice of New Truths
rules.text: In your Command phase, one model from your army with this ability can use it, if it does, select one enemy unit with 18" of it, that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.

rules.name: Scrambler Array
rules.text: Enemy units that are set up on the battlefield as Reinforcements cannot be set up within 12" of this model.

rules.name: Grinding Line-breaker
rules.text: Each time an enemy unit (excluding MONSTER and VEHICLES) that is within Engagement Range of this model Falls Back, all models in that enemy unit must take a Desperate Escape test. When doing so, if that enemy unit is Battle-shocked, subtract 1 from each of those tests.

rules.name: Fire Support
rules.text: In your Shooting phase, after this model has shot, select one enemy unit it scored one or more hits against this phase. Until the end of the phase, each time a friendly model that disembarked from this TRANSPORT this turn makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

rules.name: Brood Surge
rules.text:
Each time an enemy unit is selected to shoot, after that unit has shot, if any models from this unit were destroyed as a result of those attacks, this unit can make a Brood Surge move. To do so, roll one D6: this unit can be moved a number of inches up to the result, but it must end that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT). When doing so those models can be within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.

If, at the start of the battle, no model in this unit is equipped with a hand flamer, each time this unit makes a Brood Surge move, it can be moved up to 6" instead of up to D6". A unit cannot make a Brood Surge move while it is Battle-shocked.

rules.name: Priority Target
rules.text: In your Shooting phase, after this model's unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks made with a cult sniper rifle. Until the end of the phase, each time a friendly **^^Genestealer Cults^^** model makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

rules.name: Master Outrider
rules.text: In your Shooting phase, after this model’s unit has shot, if it is not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, that unit can make a Normal move of up to 6" as if it were your Movement phase. If it does, until the end of the turn, that unit is not eligible to declare a charge.

rules.name: Hypersensory Abilities
rules.text: Once per turn, in your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance, or Fall Back move within 9" of this model, if this unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can shoot at that unit as if it were your Shooting phase, and then make a Normal move of up to D6" (it cannot embark within a TRANSPORT as part of this move)

rules.name: Heroic Fusillade
rules.text: Once per turn, after one model from your army with this ability has shot, you can select one INFANTRY unit hit by one or more of those attacks. That unit must take a Battle-shock test.

rules.name: Bodyguard

rules.name: Psychic Familiar
rules.text: Once per battle, at the start of any of your opponent’s Shooting phases, this model can use its psychic familiar. If it does, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the range of its Mind Control ability.

rules.name: Mind Control (Psychic)
rules.text: At the start of your opponent’s Shooting phase, one PSYKER model from your army with this ability can use it. If used, select one enemy unit within 18" of and visible to that PSYKER model and roll one D6: on a 1, that PSYKER model suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 2-5, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that enemy unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll; on a 6, each time a model in that enemy unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll and subtract 1 from the Wound Roll.

rules.name: Spiritual Leader
rules.text: Once per battle, at the start of any phase, you can select one friendly GENESTELERS CULTS unit that is Battle-shocked and within 12" of this model. That unit is no longer Battle-shocked.

This ability cannot be used to return destroyed CHARACTER models in Attached units and any [ONE SHOT] weapons equipped with by returned models that were shot before they were destroyed are still considered to have been shot.

rules.text: While this model is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, you can add 1 to the Hit roll.

rules.name: Psychic Spoor
rules.text: At the start of the first battle round, select one enemy unit to be this model’s prey. Each time this model makes an attack that targets its prey, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

rules.name: Cloaked Assassin
rules.text: If this model is equipped with a Sanctus Bio-dagger, enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at this model.

rules.text: In your Command phase, you can return up to D3 destroyed models to the bearer’s unit. rules.name: Tectonic Fragdrill
rules.text: Friendly GENESTEALER CULT INFANTRY models can be set up or end any type of move on top of the floor sections of this FORTIFICATION.

rules.name: Underground Egress
rules.text: Each time one of your Cult Ambush markers is removed as the result of an enemy unit ending any kind of move within 9" of it, you can instead move that marker so that it is wholly within 9" of this FORTIFICATION and more than 9" horizontally away from all enemy units (if this is not possible, that marker is removed as normal).

rules.name: Manufactorum Cover
rules.text: Each time a ranged attack is allocated to a model, if that model is not fully visible to every model in the attacking unit because of this FORTIFICATION, that model has the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

rules.name: Fortification
rules.text:
While an enemy unit is only within Engagement Range of one or more FORTIFICATION from your army:
■ That unit can still be selected as the target of ranged attacks, but each time such an attack is made, unless it is made with a Pistol, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

rules.text: At the end of each phase, if a Beasts of Nurgle model in this unit has lost any wounds but is not destroyed, that model regains all of its lost wounds.

rules.name: Invulnerable Save
rules.text: Models in this unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.

rules.name: Mischief Makers (Aura)
rules.text: Each time an enemy unit (excluding ^^Titanic^^ units) within Engagement Range of one or more units with this ability is selected to fight, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that enemy unit makes a melee attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

rules.name: Explosive Blight
rules.text: In your Shooting phase, each time this model makes an attack that destroys an enemy unit, before removing the last model in that unit from play, roll a D6, adding 1 to the result if that unit is Afflicted; on a 5+, each enemy unit within 6" of that model is Afflicted until the start of your next turn.

rules.name: Invulnerable Save
rules.text: This model has a 5+ invulnerable save.

rules.name: Gift of Contagion (Psychic)
rules.text: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is Afflicted, that attack has the [Sustained Hits 1] ability.

rules.name: Leader
rules.text: This model can be attached to the following units: ^^**Plague Marines, Poxwalkers**^^

rules.name: Gift of Poxes
rules.text: Add 3" to the range of this model's Contagion Range.

rules.name: Leader
rules.text: This model can be attached to the following units: ^^**Plague Marines, Poxwalkers**^^

rules.name: Invulnerable Save (4+)
rules.text: This model has a 4+ invulnerable save.

rules.name: Leader
rules.text: This unit can be attached to the following units: ^^**Plague Marines, Poxwalkers**^^

rules.name: Scuttling Walker
rules.text: Each time this unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move through models (excluding ^^**Titanic**^^ models) and terrain features. When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of enemy models, but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.

rules.name: Barrage of Filth
rules.text: In your Shooting phase, after this model has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, that unit cannot have the Benefit of Cover.

rules.name: Droning Chorus
rules.text: Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.

rules.name: Insectile Murmuration
rules.text: Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is within Contagion Range of one or more DEATH GUARD units from your army, re‑roll a Wound roll of 1.

rules.name: Rejuvenating Swarm
rules.text: At the end of each phase, the bearer regains all of its lost wounds.

rules.name: Plagueveil
rules.text: While the bearer’s unit is within range of one or more objective markers that you control, that unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".

rules.name: Daemon Weapon of Nurgle
rules.text: Each time the bearer makes a melee attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

rules.name: Furnace of Plagues
rules.text: Add 1 to the Strength and Attacks characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons, and the bearer's melee weapons have the Devastating Wounds abilty.

rules.name: Lord of the Walking Pox
rules.text: If the bearer is leading a ^^**Poxwalkers**^^ unit, and is in Strategic Reserves, for the purposes of setting up that unit on the battlefield, treat the current battle round as the third battle round.

rules.name: Revolting Regeneration
rules.text: The bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

rules.name: Eye of Affliction
rules.text: Ranged weapons equipped by model's in the bearer's unit have the [Ignores Cover] ability while targeting an Afflicted enemy unit.

rules.name: Talisman of Burgeoning
rules.text: While the bearer is leading a ^^**Poxwalkers**^^ unit, add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of ^^**Poxwalkers**^^ models in that unit.

rules.name: Witherbone Pipes
rules.text: While the bearer is leading a ^^**Poxwalkers**^^ unit, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit, and each time that unit takes a Battle-shock or Leadership test, add 1 to that test.

rules.name: Sorrowsyphon
rules.text: While the bearer is leading a ^^**Poxwalkers**^^ unit, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the bearer's Plague Wind weapon. Each time the bearer makes one or more attacks with a Plague Wind weapon, after the bearer's unit has resolved its attacks, D3 Bodyguard models from the bearer's unit are destroyed.

rules.name: Face of Death
rules.text: At the start of the Fight phase, each enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer's unit must take a Battle-shock test.

rules.name: Vile Vigour
rules.text: While the bearer is leading a unit, add 1" to the Movement characteristics of models in that unit and you can re-roll Advance rolls made for that unit.

rules.name: Warprot Talisman
rules.text: Once per battle, at the end of your opponent's turn, if the bearer's unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove it from the battle field and place it into Strategic Reserves.

rules.name: Helm of the Fly King
rules.text: While the bearer is leading a unit, models in that unit cannot be targeted by ranged attacks unless the attacking model is within 18".

rules.name: Arch Contaminator
rules.text: While the bearer's unit is within range of an objective marker you control, each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

rules.name: Bilemaw Blight
rules.text: At the start of your Shooting phase, until the end of the phase, add 12" to the Range characteristics of the bearer's Plague Wind weapon.

rules.name: Shriekworm Familiar
rules.text: Once per battle round, you can target the bearer's unit with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem for 0CP.

rules.name: Tendrilous Emissions
rules.text: While the bearer is within 3" of one or more friendly ^^**Death Guard Vehicle**^^ units, the bearer has the Lone Operative ability, and each time one of those ^^**Vehicle**^^ units makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit visible to the bearer, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

rules.name: Final Ingredient
rules.text: Once per battle, after the bearer's unit has fought, if one or more ^^**Character**^^ models were destroyed by those attacks, select one Plague. Until the end of the battle, if an enemy unit is Afflicted, that unit has the effect of the selected Plague in addition to any other.

rules.name: Visions of Virulence
rules.text: While an enemy unit is enfeebled by the bearer's Pestilent Fallout ability, that unit is also Afflicted.

rules.name: Needle of Nurgle
rules.text: Each time the bearer uses its Tainted Narthecium ability, you can return up to D3 destroyed models to the bearer's unit (instead of 1).

rules.name: Cornucophagus
rules.text: In the Declare Battle Formations step, select one Plague. Until the end of the battle, while an enemy is within Contagion Range of the bearer, that enemy unit has the effect of that Plague in addition to any other.

rules.name: Beckoning Blight
rules.text: Each time a ^^**Plague Legions^^** unit from your army is set up on the battle field using the Deep Strike ability, if it is set up wholly within 12" of the bearer, it can be set up anywhere that is more than 6" horizontally away from any enemy models, instead of more than 9".

rules.name: Fell Harvester
rules.text: Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of the bearer's melee weapons.

rules.name: Entropic Knell
rules.text: In the Battle-shock step of your opponent's Command phase, each enemy unit within 6" of the bearer that is below its Starting Strength must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.

rules.name: Tome of Bounteous Blessings
rules.text: Each time a ^^**Plague Legions^^** unit within 12" of the bearer takes a Battle-shock test, add 1 to that test and, if that test is passed, one model in that unit regains up to D3 lost wounds (if that unit is a ^^**Battleline^^** unit and that test is passed, up to D3 destroyed models can be returned to that unit instead).

rules.name: Skittering Limbs
rules.text: Each time a model in this unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move through enemy models. When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of such models but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.

rules.name: Spatterfilth
rules.text: Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the Hit roll, to the Wound roll and to the Armour Penetration characteristic.

rules.name: Choking Mist
rules.text: Once per battle, when this unit is selected to make a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, is set up on the battlefield, or declares a charge it can use this Battle Trait. Until the end of the turn, enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at this unit.

rules.name: Bone Horns
rules.text: Each time this unit ends a Charge move, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of it and roll one D6 for each model in this unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

rules.name: Stolid Bulk
rules.text: Add 1 to the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit.

rules.name: Cackling Plague Mites
rules.text: Ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit have the **[IGNORES COVER]** ability.

rules.name: Quivering Cilia
rules.text: Each time you target this unit with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem, hits are scored on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+ while resolving that Stratagem.

rules.name: Infectious Buboes
rules.text: Each time a melee attack is allocated to this unit, after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, roll one D6 (to a maximum of six D6 per attacking unit): for each 5+, the attacking unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

rules.name: Sporebelch
rules.text: Each time this unit ends a Fall Back move, select one enemy unit that was within Engagement Range of this unit at the start of the phase. Roll three D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

rules.name: Lambent Taint
rules.text: In your Shooting phase, after this unit has shot, select one visible enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, each time a friendly **^^Nurgle Daemon^^** model makes an attack that targets that unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

rules.name: Plated Growths
rules.text: Each time an attack targets this unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than this unit's Toughness characteristic, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

rules.name: Masterwork Maladies
rules.text: Add 6" to the Range characteristic of ranged Lethal Hits weapons equipped by models in this unit.

rules.name: Casket of Corruption
rules.text: The bearer has the Deadly Demise D3 ability. In addition, at the end of the battle, if the bearer's unit is wholly within your opponent's deployment zone, when you next follow the Path of Contagion, you can skip the Counteragents step.

rules.name: Orb of Decay
rules.text: Once per battle, when you target the bearer's unit with the Grenade Stratagem, the bearer can use this Crusade Relic. If they do, until that Stratagem has been resolved, add 2 to the result of each dice you roll for that Stratagem.

rules.name: Putrid Heart
rules.text: The bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability. In addition, add 6" to the Contagion Range of models in the bearer's unit.

rules.name: Bountiful Censer
rules.text: Each time a friendly model with the Deadly Demise ability within 9" of the bearer is destroyed, the bearer can use this Crusade Relic. If it does, add 2 to the roll to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by that model's Deadly Demise ability. You cannot target that model with the Putrid Detonation Stratagem.

rules.name: Gnawing Tome
rules.text: Each time an enemy unit within 9" of the bearer's unit fails a Battle-shock test, roll one D6: on a 4+, you gain 1 Requisition point.

rules.name: Foulforged Armour
rules.text: The bearer has a Save characteristic of 2+.

rules.name: Slitherswift Limbs
rules.text: Add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for this model's unit.

rules.name: Veil of Flies
rules.text: Models in this model's unit have the Stealth ability.

rules.name: Febrile Vitality
rules.text: Add 1" to the Move characteristic of models in this model's unit.

rules.name: Billowing Miasma
rules.text: Add 6" to this model's Contagion Range.

rules.name: Grossly Swollen
rules.text: Add 2 to this model's Wounds characteristic.

rules.name: Leprous Insensibility
rules.text: This model has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

rules.name: Writhing Tentacles
rules.text: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by this model.

rules.name: Touch of Rot
rules.text: Improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by this model by 1.

rules.name: Plaguesight
rules.text: Each time this model makes an attack that targets an Afflicted unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

rules.name: Vile Possession
rules.text: Each time you add a **^^Vehicle^^** unit to your Crusade force, add the **^^Daemon^^** keyword to that unit's keywords (if it does not already have it) and that unit gains 6XP (immediately gaining the Blooded Rank); select one Battle Honour for it as normal.

rules.name: Burgeoning Fortitude
rules.text: After each Crusade battle, you can ignore your first Out of Action test.

rules.name: Eye of Nurgle
rules.text: After each Crusade battle, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if you won the battle. On a 6+, select one additional unit to be Marked for Greatness.

rules.name: Fecund Fervour
rules.text: After each Crusade battle, each **^^Battleline^^** unit that was part of your Crusade army and survived the battle gains 2XP.

rules.name: Seeping Poisons
rules.text: When a unit from your Crusade force gains the Weapon Modifications Battle Honour, you can choose for that weapon to gain **[LETHAL HITS]** instead of randomly generating Weapon Modifications for that weapon.

rules.name: Endless Harvest
rules.text: After each Crusade battle, roll one D6: on a 4+, you gain 1 additional Requisition point.

rules.name: Spreading Pox
rules.text: If one or more units were destroyed by attacks made with Lethal Hits weapons while your Pathogen is active, the first **^^Poxwalkers^^** unit added to your Crusade force after this battle gains 6XP (immediately gaining the Blooded rank); select one Battle Honour for it as normal (even though **^^Poxwalkers^^** units cannot normally gain XP or Battle Honours).

rules.name: Putridity
rules.text: Each time this model makes an attack with a Lethal Hits weapon, a unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

rules.name: Drawback
rules.text: Subtract 3 from the Strength characteristic of Lethal Hits weapons equipped by this model.

rules.name: Hypervector
rules.text: In your Shooting phase, after this model's unit has shot, if this model made one or more attacks with a Lethal Hits weapon, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the battle, that enemy unit is Afflicted. Only one model in each unit can use this ability per turn.

rules.name: Drawback
rules.text: Subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of ranged Lethal Hits weapons equipped by this model.

rules.name: Parasitic Implantation
rules.text: Lethal Hits weapons equipped by this model have the **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]** ability.

rules.name: Drawback
rules.text: Each time this model makes an attack with a Lethal Hits weapon, you cannot re-roll the Hit roll.

rules.name: Lurid Flux
rules.text: In the Fight phase, after this model's unit has fought, if this model made one or more attacks with a Lethal Hits weapon, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. Only one model in each unit can use this ability per turn.

rules.name: Invulnerable Save (4+)
rules.text: This model has a 4+ invulnerable save.

rules.name: Leader
rules.text: This model can be attached to the following units: ^^**Blightlord Terminators, Deathshroud Terminators**^^

rules.name: Foul Infusion
rules.text: While this model is leading a unit, weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [Lethal Hits] ability. In addition, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, a Critical hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+, instead of only 6.

rules.name: Malicious Calculations
rules.text: While this model is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack's Ballistic Skill or Weapon Skill characteristics and/or any or all modifiers to the Hit roll.

rules.name: Putrefying Stink
rules.text: Enemy models cannot start or end an Advance move within 9" of this model.

rules.name: Shroud of Disease
rules.text: While this model is leading a unit, that unit cannot be targeted by ranged attacks unless the attacking model is within 18".

rules.name: Sickening Vitality
rules.text: While this model is leading a unit, add 1" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit and you can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for that unit.

rules.name: Tainted Narthecium
rules.text: While this model is leading a unit, in your Command phase, you can return one destroyed Bodyguard model to that unit.

rules.name: Tocsin of Misery (Aura)
rules.text: In the Battle-shock step of your opponent's Command phase, if an enemy unit that is below its Starting Strength is within 9" of one or more models with this ability, that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test if it is a ^^**Psyker**^^ unit.

rules.name: Unclean Icon
rules.text: While this model is leading a unit, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit.

rules.name: Vector of Disease
rules.text: While this model is leading a unit, melee weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [Sustained Hits 1] and [Lance] abilities.

rules.name: Chaos Lord
rules.text: While this model is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

rules.name: Dessication Conduit (Aura)
rules.text: While an enemy unit is within Contagion Range of this model, at the end of the turn, roll one D6: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

rules.name: Damaged: 1-5 wounds remaining
rules.text: While this model has 1-5 wounds remaining, each time this model makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

rules.name: Leader
rules.text:
This model can be attached to the following unit: ^^**Plague Marines^^**
*You can attach this model to a ^^**Plague Marines^^** unit, even if one other Leader unit has already been attached to it (you cannot attach more than one of the same Leader to the same unit). If you do, and that Bodyguard unit is destroyed, the Leader units attached to it become separate units, with their original Starting Strengths.*

rules.name: Frenzy
rules.text: Each time an enemy unit is selected to shoot or fight, after it has finished making its attacks, if one or more of those attacks targeted this model and this model is not destroyed, this model can fight as if it were the Fight phase

rules.name: Borewyrm Infestation
rules.text:
Twice per battle, at the end of your opponent’s turn, if this model is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove this model from the battlefield. In the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase, set it up anywhere on the battlefield that
is more than 9" horizontally away from all enemy models. If the battle ends and this unit is not on the battlefield, it is destroyed. 

Designer’s Note: Place two Borewyrm Infestation tokens next to this model, removing one each time this ability has been used.

rules.name: Vantage Point
rules.text: While a model is on top of the tower roof of this FORTIFICATION, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by that model by 1.

rules.name: Drone Commander (Aura)
rules.text: While a friendly **^^Spindle Drones^^** unit is within 6" of this model, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

rules.name: Tremor Quake
rules.text: In your Shooting phase, just after selecting a target for this model’s Aquila macro-cannon, the target unit and every other enemy INFANTRY unit within 3" of that unit must take a Battle-shock test.

rules.name: Emergency Plasma Vents
rules.text: Each time this FORTIFICATION suffers a mortal wound as the result of a failed Hazardous test, roll one D6: on a 4+, that wound is not lost.

rules.name: Skyshield
rules.text: Friendly Infantry models and friendly units that can Fly can be set up or end any type of move on top of the platform section of this Fortification. While such a model is on the platform section of this Fortification, that model has a 5+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks

rules.name: Repair Aircraft
rules.text: At the end of your Movement phase, if there is a friendly Aircraft model on top of this Fortification, that Aircraft regains up to D3 lost wounds

rules.name: Threat Level Rising
rules.text: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll if this unit is below its Starting Strength, and add 1 to the Wound roll as well if this unit is Below Half-strength

rules.name: Fearsome Assault
rules.text: At the start of the Fight phase, each enemy unit within Engagement Range of one or more units with this ability must take a Battle-shock test.

rules.name: Disruptive Influence (Aura)
rules.text: While an enemy unit is within 6" of this model, each time that unit takes a Battle-shock or Leadership test, subtract 1 from that test.

rules.name: Automated Defences
rules.text:
Each time this model makes a ranged attack that targets the closest enemy unit:
- If that attack is made with a Punisher gatling cannon and the target is not a MONSTER or VEHICLE, add 1 to the Hit roll.
- If that attack is made with a battle cannon and the target is a MONSTER or VEHICLE, add 1 to the Hit roll.
- If that attack is made with a quad-lascannon and the target can FLY, add 1 to the Hit roll.

rules.name: Projected Void Shields (Aura)
rules.text: While a friendly model is wholly within 6" of this FORTIFICATION, that model has a 4+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks.

rules.name: Vortex
rules.text: In your Shooting phase, each time you select a target for this model’s vortex missile battery, roll one D6 for the target unit and one D6 for every other enemy unit within 3" of the target unit. On a 4+, the unit being rolled for is struck by the vortex; after resolving all of this model’s attacks against the target unit, each unit struck by the vortex suffers D3 mortal wounds.

rules.name: Inviolable Bastion
rules.text: Each time an attack is allocated to this Fortification, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

rules.name: Comms Antenna
rules.text: In your Command phase, if one or more Character models are embarked within this Fortification, roll one D6: on a 5+, you gain 1CP

rules.name: Damaged: 1-30 Wounds Remaining
rules.text: While this model has 1-30 wounds remaining, each time this model makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

rules.name: Fortress
rules.text: When this FORTIFICATION is set up, all parts of it must be set up in contact with another part.

rules.name: Stronghold
rules.text: Friendly INFANTRY models can be set up or end any type of move on top of the roof section of this FORTIFICATION. Any friendly model can be set up or end any type of move on the ramp or platform section of this FORTIFICATION.

rules.name: Damaged: 1-15 Wounds Remaining
rules.text: While this model has 1-15 wounds remaining, each time this model makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

rules.name: Defensive Emplacement
rules.text: In the Create the Battlefield and Place Objective Markers step, set this model up in one of the Sentry Gun positions (marked D1 on the mission map).

rules.name: Enemy Spotted
rules.text: Each time a model from your army makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit that is within 9" of and visible to any Searchlights from your army, re-roll a Hit of 1 and, if the model making that attack is a Sentry Gun, add 1 to the Hit roll as well.

rules.name: Wall
rules.text: This model is a terrain feature and counts as a Wall.

rules.name: Camera Network
rules.text: In the Create the Battlefield and Place Objective Markers step, set this terrain feature up in one of the Searchlight positions (marked D2 on the mission map) that does not already contain a Searchlight.

rules.name: Limited Loadout
rules.text: This model cannot attempt to operate Hatchways and cannot perform Tactical Manoeuvres.

rules.name: Assault Robot
rules.text: In the Deploy Armies step, when setting up a unit from your army within an Entry Zone, you can set this model up alongside that unit as if it was part of it, using the same Entry Zone.

rules.name: Bomb Kit
rules.text:
When the bearer is destroyed (other than through triggering its bomb, as described below), roll one D6 before removing it from play: on a 6 it explodes, and each other unit within 3" of and visible to the bearer suffers 1 mortal wound.

In your Command phase, the bearer can trigger its bombs. If it does:
- Open each Hatchway that is within 3" of the bearer. Your opponent cannot attempt to prevent those Hatchways from opening, and those Hatchways cannot be closed again.
- Roll one D6 for each other unit within 3" of and visible to the bearer: on a 2+, that unit suffers 1 mortal wound. The bearer is then destroyed.

rules.name: Cutting Gear
rules.text: Each time the bearer ends a Normal move, you can open one Hatchway that is within 1" of it. Your opponent cannot attempt to prevent that Hatchway from opening.

rules.name: Reinforced Cover
rules.text: Each time a ranged attack is allocated to a model, if that model is not fully visible to every model in the attacking unit because of this FORTIFICATION, that model has the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

rules.name: Roof Access
rules.text: Friendly INFANTRY models can be set up or end any type of move on top of the roof section of this FORTIFICATION.

rules.name: Gates
rules.text: When this FORTIFICATION is first set up on the battlefield, each gate section can be set up with its gate open or closed. In your Command phase, you can open or close the gate of each of this model’s gate sections. While a gate is open, models can move and draw line of sight through it as if it were not there.

rules.name: Battlements
rules.text: Friendly INFANTRY models can be set up or end any type of move on top of the flat battlement sections of this FORTIFICATION.

rules.name: Defence Line
rules.text: When this FORTIFICATION is set up, all parts of it must be set up within 1" of another part. While an INFANTRY model has the Benefit of Cover as a result of this FORTIFICATION (see below), that model has a 4+ invulnerable save.

rules.name: Trench Line
rules.text: Friendly INFANTRY models can be set up or end any type of move on top of the flat platform section of this FORTIFICATION.

rules.name: Damaged: 1-6 Wounds Remaining
rules.text: While this model has 1-6 wounds remaining, each time this model makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

rules.name: Damaged: 1-10 Wounds Remaining
rules.text: While this model has 1-10 wounds remaining, each time this model makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

rules.name: Mighty Edifice
rules.text: You can only include this FORTIFICATION in your army in games of Onslaught size or greater.

rules.name: Emplacement Platform
rules.text: Friendly **^^Astra Militarum Infantry**^^ models can be set up or end any type of move on top of the platform section of this **^^Fortification^^**.

rules.name: Reinforced Cover
rules.text: Each time a ranged attack is allocated to a model, if that model is not fully visible to every model in the attacking unit because of this **^^Fortification^^**, that model has the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

rules.name: Defence Line
rules.text: While an **^^Astra Militarum Infantry^^** model has the Benefit of Cover as a result of this terrain feature, that model has a 4+ invulnerable save

rules.name: Deployment
rules.text: When this model is set up, it will consist of 1 platform section, up to 5 shield sections, up to 2 broken shield sections and up to 2 end sections. All sections must be connected to each other to form a continuous defence line; the 2 broken shield sections can be placed either at the end of the defence line, or in the middle of it such that both are within ½" of each other (in this case, these 2 sections count as being connected to each other). All of the sections that have been set up are then treated as a single model for all rules purposes.

rules.name: Mobile Hunter-killers
rules.text: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack that targets a **^^Monster^^** or **^^Vehicle^^** unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

rules.name: Horsemasters
rules.text: This unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

rules.name: Rolling Fortress
rules.text: Each time a ranged attack is allocated to an **^^Astra Militarum^^** model from your army, if that model is not fully visible to every model in the attacking unit because of this **^^Baneblade^^** model, that model has the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

rules.name: Tremor Quake
rules.text: In your Shooting phase, just after selecting a target for this model’s tremor cannon, the target unit and every other enemy **^^Infantry^^** unit within 3" of that unit must take a Battle-shock test.

rules.name: Transport

rules.name: Bizarrely Resilient
rules.text: Each time an attack targets this model, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

rules.name: Trample
rules.text: Each time this model is selected to fight, you can select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of it and roll one D6, adding 2 to the result if this model made a Charge move this turn: on a 4-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 6+, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

rules.name: Damaged: 1-6 Wounds Remaining
rules.text: While this model has 1-6 wounds remaining, each time this model makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

rules.name: Gargantuan
rules.text: Each time this model makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move over models (excluding TITANIC models) and terrain features that are 4" or less in height as if they were not there.

rules.name: Walking Bastion
rules.text: This model does not suffer the penalty to its Hit rolls for making ranged attacks while enemy units are within Engagement Range of it.

rules.name: Damaged: 1-10 Wounds Remaining
rules.text: While this model has 1-10 wounds remaining, subtract 6 from this model’s Objective Control characteristic and each time this model makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

rules.name: Wall of Dakka
rules.text: Each time this model makes a ranged attack that targets a unit within half range, add 1 to the Hit roll.

rules.name: Damaged: 1-8 Wounds Remaining
rules.text: While this model has 1-8 wounds remaining, subtract 5 from this model’s Objective Control characteristic and each time this model makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

rules.name: Mega Carnage
rules.text: Each time this model is selected to fight, you can select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of it and roll one D6, adding 2 to the result if this model made a Charge move this turn: on a 4-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 6+, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

rules.name: Mekaniak
rules.text: At the end of your Movement phase, you can select one friendly ORKS VEHICLE model within 3" of this model. That VEHICLE model regains up to D3 lost wounds, and, until the start of your next Movement phase, each time that VEHICLE model makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll. Each model can only be selected for this ability once per turn.

rules.name: Spiked Ram
rules.text: Each time this model ends a Charge move, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of it and roll one D6: on a 2-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 6, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

rules.name: Speedboss
rules.text: While this model is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

rules.name: High-octane Fuel
rules.text: Each time this model’s unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in this model’s unit.

rules.name: Drive-by Krumpin'
rules.text: Each time this unit Consolidates, each model in this unit can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".

rules.name: Speed Freeks Mob

rules.name: Big Booms

After this model has finished making its attacks against that target unit this phase, each unit struck by a concussive wave this phase suffers D3 mortal wounds.

rules.name: Da Revolushun!
rules.text: While this model is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

If you do, you intone the Hymns of Battle that battle round and, until the start of the next battle round, all **^^Adepta Sororitas Character^^** units in your army gain bonus depending on which Hymns of Battle you select. While a unit is Battle-shocked, it loses the bonus of any Hymns that would apply to it (if a rule would cause such a unit to no longer be Battle-shocked, any bonuses from Hymns that would apply to it apply once again).

rules.name: Eviscerating Fly-by
rules.text: Each time this unit ends a Normal move, you can select one enemy unit (excluding Monster and Vehicle units) that it moved over during that move. If you do, roll one D6 for each model in this unit: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

rules.name: Invulnerable Save
rules.text: This unit has a 6+ Invulnerable save

rules.name: Aethersails
rules.text: Each time this model Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of this model.

rules.name: Invulnerable Save
rules.text: This unit has a 6+ Invulnerable save

rules.name: Lithe Embarkation
rules.text: At the end of the Fight phase, if there are no models currently embarked within this Transport, you can select one friendly Ynnari Infantry unit that only includes models from the units listed in this unit's Transport section, that has 6 or fewer models and that is wholly within 6" of this Transport. Unless that unit is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can embark within this Transport.

rules.name: Swift as the wind
rules.text:
■ Trigger: When an eligible unit from your army is selected to make a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move. You can trigger this Agile Manoeuvre more than once per phase (provided a different unit performs it each time).
■ Effect: Until the end of the phase, add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit.

rules.name: Flitting Shadows
rules.text:
■ Trigger: When an eligible unit from your army is selected to make a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, is set up on the battlefield, or declares a charge.
■ Effect: Until the end of the turn, enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at that unit.

rules.name: Star Engines
rules.text:
■ Trigger: When an eligible ^^Vehicle^^ unit from your army is selected to make an Advance move.
■ Effect: Until the end of the turn, Ranged weapons equipped by this unit have the ^^**[Assault]**^^ ability.

rules.name: Sudden Strike
rules.text:
■ Trigger: When an eligible unit from your army is selected to fight.
■ Effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".

rules.name: Opportunity Seized
rules.text:
■ Trigger: When an enemy unit ends a Fall Back move.
■ Effect: One eligible unit from your army (excluding ^^Titanic^^ units) that started the phase within Engagement Range of that enemy unit can make a Normal move of up to D6+1".

rules.name: Fade Back
rules.text:
■ Trigger: In your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
■ Effect: One eligible unit from you army (excluding ^^Titanic^^ units) that was hit by one or more of those attacks can make a Normal move of up to D6+1".

rules.name: Aspect Shrine Token
rules.text:
Once per battle for each Aspect Shrine token this unit has, you can change the result of one Hit roll or one Wound roll made for a model in this unit (excluding ^^**Character**^^ models) to an unmodified 6.

For every 5 models in this unit, it can have 1 Aspect Shrine token.

rules.name: Leader
rules.text:
This model can be attached to the following units:
■ Hand of the Archon
■ Incubi
■ Kabalite Warriors

rules.name: Archon of the Poisoned Tongue (Pain)
rules.text: In your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when you select this model's unit to shoot or fight, you can spend 1 Pain token to Empower that unit. If you do, select one of the following abilities: **^^[Sustained Hits 1]; [Lethal Hits]^^**. Until the end of the phase, while that unit is Empowered, weapons equipped by models in that unit have that selected ability.

rules.name: Precognisant
rules.text: If you army includes this model, after both players have deployed their armies, select up to three ^^**Drukhari**^^ units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves if you wish, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

rules.name: Mind Like a Steel Trap [Aura]
rules.text: Each time your opponent targets a unit from their army with a Stratagem, if that unit is within 12" of this model, increase the cost of that use of that Stratagem by 1CP.

rules.name: Phantasm Grenade Launcher
rules.text: The bearer’s unit has the ^^**Smoke**^^ keyword.

rules.name: Kabalite icon
rules.text: While the bearer's unit is not Battle-shocked, add 1 to the bearer's Objective Control characteristic.

rules.name: Stimm-needler
rules.text: Once per turn, the first time a saving throw is failed for a model in the bearer's unit, change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0.

rules.name: Invulnerable Save
rules.text: This unit has a 6+ Invulnerable save

rules.name: Assassins' Poisons (Pain)
rules.text: In your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when you select this unit to shoot or fight, you can spend 1 Pain token to Empower this unit. While Empowered, weapons equipped by models in this unit (excluding blast pistols, blasters and dark lances) have the ^^**[Lethal Hits]**^^ and ^^**[Precision]**^^ abilities.

rules.name: Archon's Will
rules.text: At the start of the first battle round, select one objective marker on the battlefield. Until the end of the battle, while this unit is within range of that objective marker, unless this unit is Battle-shocked, models in this unit have a 5+ invulnerable save and an Objective Control characteristic of 3.

rules.name: Archon's Retinue
rules.text: If this unit has a Leader unit attached to it during the Declare Battle Formations step, that Leader unit gains the Scouts 7" ability.

rules.name: Invulnerable Save
rules.text: This unit has a 5+ Invulnerable save

rules.name: Murderous Crossfire
rules.text: After this unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, each time a friendly ^^**Drukhari**^^ unit makes a ranged attack that targets that enemy unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. The same enemy unit can only be affected by this ability once per turn.

rules.name: Swooping Descent (Pain)
rules.text: In your Movement phase, you can spend 1 Pain token to Empower this unit. While Empowered, each time a model in this unit is set up on the battlefield using the Deep Strike ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units. When doing so, if this unit is set up within 9" of one or more enemy units, until the end of the turn, it is not eligible to declare a charge.

rules.name: Invulnerable Save (Prince Yriel)

rules.name: Fury of the Void (Psychic)
rules.text: In your Shooting phase, after this model’s unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more attacks made with this model’s Dread of the Deep Void. Until the end of the turn, that unit is riven. Each time an ^^**Aeldari**^^ model from your army makes an attack that targets a riven unit, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of that attack.

rules.name: Hallucinogen Grenades
rules.text: At the start of your opponent’s Shooting phase, this unit can use this ability. If it does, select one ^^**Aeldari**^^ Infantry unit from your army visible to and within 36" of this unit: until the end of the phase, that unit has the Stealth ability.

rules.name: Raid and Run
rules.text: At the end of the Fight phase, if this unit was eligible to fight this phase, and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to D3+3". Otherwise, if this unit was eligible to fight this phase, this unit can make a Fall Back move of up to D3+3".

rules.name: Invulnerable Save (Archtormentor)
rules.text: An Archtormentor has a 4+ Invulnerable save

rules.name: Hatred Eternal (Pain)
rules.text: In your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when you select this model’s unit to shoot or fight, you can spend 1 Pain token to Empower that unit. While that unit is Empowered, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

rules.name: Cruel Example
rules.text: Each time this model makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, you can add 1 to the Wound roll. Each time this model’s unit destroys a CHARACTER model, you gain 1CP.

rules.name: Pain Adept
rules.text: In your Command phase, if one or more models from your army with this ability are on the battlefield, roll one D6: on a 4+, you gain 1 Pain token.

rules.name: Awakened Spirit
rules.text: Each time this model makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

rules.name: Cluster Caltrops
rules.text: Each time you roll to inflict wounds using this unit’s Eviscerating Fly-by ability, you can re-roll one D6 for each model in this unit equipped with cluster caltrops.

rules.name: Grav Talon
rules.text: The bearer’s melee weapons have an Armour Penetration characteristic of -2 and the ^^**[Lethal Hits]**^^ ability.

rules.name: The Falling Blade
rules.text: You can re-roll Charge rolls made for this unit.

rules.name: Soulseeing
rules.text: Ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit (excluding **^^Support Weapon^^** models) have the **[IGNORES COVER]** ability, and each time a model in this unit (excluding **^^Support Weapon^^** models) makes a ranged attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack's Ballistic Skill characteristic and/or any or all modifiers to the Hit roll.

rules.name: Psy-prism
rules.text: Psychic weapons equipped by models in this unit have the **[SUSTAINED HITS 2]** ability.

rules.name: Fallen Foreseen
rules.text: Each time a model in this unit is destroyed by a ranged attack, roll one D6: on a 3+, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can shoot after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

rules.name: Crystalline Targeting Matrix
rules.text: Ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit have the **[ASSAULT]** ability.

rules.name: Hallucinogen Launchers
rules.text: This unit has the **^^Smoke^^** keyword, and you can target it with the Smokescreen Stratagem for 0CP.

rules.name: Star Engines
rules.text: This unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

rules.name: Desperate Protectors
rules.text: Each time you target this unit with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem, hits are scored on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+ while resolving that Stratagem. If this unit, is within range of one or more objective markers, hits are scored on unmodified Hit rolls of 4+ instead.

rules.name: Sombre Determination
rules.text: Add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in this unit.

rules.name: Seasoned Protectors
rules.text: Ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit have the **[HEAVY]** ability.

rules.name: Fell the Mighty
rules.text: Each time a melee attack made by a model in this unit is allocated to a **^^Monster^^** or **^^Vehicle^^** model, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that attack.

rules.name: Graceful Advance
rules.text: Models in this unit have the Scouts 8" ability.

rules.name: Preternatural Acrobatics
rules.text: This unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

rules.name: Farstrike
rules.text: Add 6" to the Range characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit. For each of those weapons with the **[TORRENT]**, add 3" to the Range characteristic of that weapon instead.

rules.name: Way of Stone
rules.text: Each time a ranged attack targets this unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than this unit's Toughness characteristic, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

rules.name: Hunter's Eye
rules.text: Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit within half range, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

rules.name: Bladeweave
rules.text: Each time a melee attack targets this unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

rules.name: Shadowswift
rules.text: This unit cannot be targeted by ranged attacks unless the attacking model is within 18".

rules.name: Shimmerplume of Achillrial
rules.text: **^^Autarch^^** model only. Each time a ranged attack targets the bearer's unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll and subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

rules.name: Mask of Secrets
rules.text: **^^Harlequins^^** model only. The bearer has the Twisted Phantasm (Aura) ability.

rules.name: Twisted Phantasm (Aura)
rules.text: While an enemy unit is within 6" of this model, each time your opponent targets that unit with a Stratagem, increase the cost of that usage of that Stratagem to 1CP.

rules.name: Raiment of the Laughing God
rules.text: **^^Harlequins^^** model only. The bearer's unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back. In addition, add 2 to Advance and Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit.

rules.name: Kaela Mensha Shelwe, Song of the Bloody-handed
rules.text: **^^Asuryani^^** model only. The bearer's melee weapons have the **[ANTI-BEASTS 3+]]**, **[ANTI-INFANTRY 3+]]**, **[ANTI-MOUNTED 3+]]** and **[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]]** abilities. In addition, at the end of the Fight phase, if the bearer destroyed one or more enemy models that phase (excluding **^^Vehicles^^**), the bearer regains up to D3 lost wounds.

rules.name: Serpent's Tail
rules.text: **^^Harlequins^^** model only. Each time the bearer is selected to fight, after resolving those attacks, each enemy unit within 6" of the bearer's unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.

rules.name: Rune of Faolchú
rules.text: **^^Aeldari^^** model only. At the end of your Movement phase, select one enemy unit within 18" of and visible to the bearer. Until the end of your next Movement phase, each time a friendly **^^Aeldari^^** model makes an attack that targets that unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

rules.name: Banner of Asuryan
rules.text: **^^Autarch^^** model only. At the start of the battle round, if the bearer is on the battlefield, you gain 1 additional Battle Focus token.

rules.name: Guiding Presence
rules.text: Aeldari Psyker model only. At the start of your Shooting phase, select one friendly Aeldari Vehicle model within 9" of the bearer. Until the end of the phase, each time that model makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

rules.name: Harmonisation Matrix
rules.text: Aeldari model only. In your Command phase, if the bearer (or any Transport it is embarked within) is within range of an objective marker you control, roll one D6: on a 3+, you gain 1CP.

rules.name: Spirit Stone of Raelyth
rules.text: Aeldari Psyker model only. While the bearer is within 3" of one or more friendly Aeldari Vehicle units, the bearer has the Lone Operative ability. In your Command phase, you can select one friendly Aeldari Vehicle model within 3" of the bearer. That model regains up to D3 lost wounds.

rules.name: Guileful Strategist
rules.text: Aeldari model only. If your army includes the bearer, after both players have deployed their armies, select up to three Aeldari Vehicle units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, any of those units can be placed into Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

rules.name: Aspect of Murder
rules.text: **^^Autarch^^** or **^^Autarch Wayleaper^^** model only. Add 1 to the Damage characteristics of melee weapons equipped by the bearer, and those weapons have the **[PRECISION]** ability.

rules.name: Mantle of Wisdom
rules.text: ^^**Autarch^^** or ^^**Autarch Wayleaper^^** model only. While the bearer is leading an ^^**Aspect Warriors^^** unit, each time that unit is selected to shoot or fight, until the end of the phase, models in that unit gain both of the abilities from the Path of the Warrior Detachment rule.

rules.name: Shimmerstone
rules.text: Autarch or Autarch Wayleaper model only. While the bearer is leading an Aspect Warriors unit, each time a ranged attack targets that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

rules.name: Strategic Savant
rules.text: Autarch or Autarch Wayleaper model only. While the bearer is leading an Aspect Warriors unit, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit.

rules.name: Gaze of Ynnead
rules.text: Farseer model only. The bearer's Eldritch Storm weapon has the [Devastating Wounds] ability.

rules.name: Storm of Whispers
rules.text: Warlock model only. In your Shooting phase, after the bearer has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. That unit must take a Battle-shock test.

rules.name: Borrowed Vigour
rules.text: **^^Archon^^** model only. Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of the bearer's melee weapons.

rules.name: Morbid Might
rules.text: Succubus model only. Each time the bearer makes a melee attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

rules.name: Cegorach's Coil
rules.text: Troupe Master model only. Each time the bearer's unit ends a Charge move, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer's unit, then roll one D6 for each model in the bearer's unit that is within Engagment Range of that enemy unit: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

rules.name: Mask of Secrets
rules.text: Harlequins model only. Each time an enemy unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) within Engagement Range of the bearer's unit Falls Back, all models in that enemy unit must take a Desperate Escape test. When doing so, if that enemy unit is Battle-shocked, subtract 1 from each of those tests.

rules.name: Murder's Jest
rules.text: Death Jester model only. Each time the bearer makes an attack that targets a unit that is below Half-strength, each successful Hit scores a Critical Hit.

rules.name: Mistweave
rules.text: Shadowseer model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Infiltrators ability.

rules.name: Craftworld's Champion
rules.text: Asuryani model only. The bearer has an Objective Control characteristic of 5.

rules.name: Ethereal Pathway
rules.text: Asuryani model only. In the Deploy Armies step, select up to two Guardians units from your army. Models in the selected units have the Infiltrators ability.

rules.name: Protector of the Paths
rules.text: Asuryani model only. While the bearer is leading a Dire Avengers or Guardians unit, once per battle round, you can target the bearer's unit with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem for 0CP, and while resolving that Stratagem, hits are scored on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+, or unmodified Hit rolls of 4+ instead if the bearer's unit is within range of an objective marker you control.

rules.name: Breath of Vaul
rules.text: **^^Asuryani^^** model only. While the bearer is leading a **^^Storm Guardians^^** unit, each time you roll to determine the number of attacks made with a flamer equipped by a model in that unit, you can re-roll the result, and each time you make a Damage roll for a model equipped with a Guardian fusion gun in that unit, you can re-roll the result.

rules.name: Crucible of Malediction
rules.text: **^^Haemonculus^^** model only. Once per battle, in your Shooting phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, you can spend 1 Pain token. Then, each enemy unit within 12" of the bearer must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test if you spent 1 Pain token. Each time a **^^Psyker^^** unit fails that test, it suffers 3 mortal wounds.

rules.name: Eye of Spite
rules.text: **^^Succubus^^** model only. Improve the Attacks and Armour Penetration characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons by 1. Each time the bearer's unit is selected to fight, you can spend 1 Pain token; if you do, until the end of the phase, improve the Attacks and Armour Penetration characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons by 2 instead.

rules.name: Labyrinthine Cunning
rules.text:
**^^Archon^^** model only. At the start of your Command phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, you can do one of the following:
Spend 1 Pain token and gain 1CP.
Roll one D6: on a 4+, you gain 1CP.

rules.name: Dark Vitality
rules.text: **^^Drukhari^^** model only. The bearer's unit is always Empowered - you do not need to spend any Pain tokens to activate that unit's Pain abilities

rules.name: Archraider
rules.text: ^^**Harlequins**^^ or ^^**Drukhari**^^ model only. In the Declare Battle Formations step, if the bearer starts the battle embarked within a ^^**Dedicated Transport**^^, that ^^**Dedicated Transport**^^ has the Scouts 9" ability.

rules.name: Webway walker
rules.text: ^^**Harlequins**^^ or ^^**Drukhari**^^ model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Deep Strike ability. Each time the bearer’s unit is set up on the battlefield using the Deep Strike ability, if that unit is currently losing the wager, until the end of the turn, you can re‑roll Charge rolls made for that unit.

rules.name: Reaper's Cowl
rules.text: ^^**Harlequins**^^ model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Stealth and Infiltrators abilities.

rules.name: Conductor of Torment
rules.text:
^^**Drukhari**^^ model only. In your Command phase, you can do one of the following:
■ If your ^^**Drukhari**^^ units are currently losing the wager, you can gain 1 Pain token. If you do, ^^**Drukhari**^^ units from your army are now winning the wager.
■ If your ^^**Drukhari**^^ units are currently winning the wager, you can discard 1 Pain token. If you do, ^^**Harlequins**^^ units from your army are now winning the wager.

rules.name: Lucid Eye
rules.text: Asuryani Psyker model only. In your Command phase, you can add 1 to or subtract 1 from the value of one Fate dice in your Fate dice pool.

rules.name: Runes of Warding
rules.text: Asuryani Psyker model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds, Psychic Attacks and Critical Wounds caused by attacks with the [Devastating Wounds] ability.

rules.name: Stone of Eldritch Fury
rules.text: Asuryani Psyker model only. Add 12" to the Range characteristic of ranged Psychic weapons equipped by the bearer.

rules.name: Torc of Morai-Heg
rules.text: Asuryani Psyker model only. Once per turn, when your opponent targets a unit from their army within 12" of the bearer with a Stratagem, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, increase the CP cost of that usage of that Stratagem by 1CP.

rules.name: Phantasmal Smoke
rules.text:
^^**Drukhari**^^ model only. While the bearer’s unit is wholly within 6" of a friendly ^^**Drukhari Transport**^^:
Models in the bearer’s unit have the  Stealth ability

rules.name: Sadistic Fulcrum
rules.text: ^^**Drukhari**^^ model only. rules.name: Spiteful Raider
rules.text: ^^**Drukhari**^^ model only. Each time the bearer’s unit destroys an enemy unit in the Fight phase, if that enemy unit was within range of one or more objective markers when the bearer’s unit was selected to fight, you gain 1 additional Pain token.

rules.name: Nightmare Shroud

rules.name: Light of Clarity

rules.name: Stave of Kurnous

Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, on a Critical Wound, that attack has the [Precision] ability.

rules.name: Rune of Mists
rules.text: Spiritseer model only. In your Command phase, select one friendly Wraith Construct unit within 12" of the bearer. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a ranged attack targets that unit, unless the attacking model is within 18, models in that unit have the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

rules.name: Higher Duty
rules.text: Spiritseer model only. Oncer per turn, when an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 9" of the bearer, the bearer's unit can make a normal move of up to 6".

rules.name: Psychic Destroyer
rules.text: ^^Asuryani^^ ^^Psyker^^ model only. Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of ranged Psychic weapons equipped by the bearer.

rules.name: Phoenix Gem
rules.text: ^^Asuryani^^ model only. The first time the bearer is destroyed, remove it from play, then, at the end of the phase, roll one D6: on a 2+, set the bearer back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of one of more enemy units, with its full wounds remaining.

rules.name: Gift of Foresight
rules.text: ^^Asuryani^^ model only. Once per battle round, you can target the bearer's unit with the Command Re-roll Stratagem for 0CP.

rules.name: Timeless Strategist
rules.text: ^^Asuryani^^ model only. At the start of the battle round, if the bearer is on the battlefield (or any Transport it is embarked within is on the battlefield), you receive 1 additional Battle Focus token.

rules.name: Firstdrawn Blade
rules.text: Asuryani Mounted model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Scouts 9" ability.

rules.name: Mirage Field
rules.text: Asuryani Mounted model only. Each time an attack targets the bearer's unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

rules.name: Seersight Strike
