rules.name: Student of the Codex
rules.text:
Adeptus Astartes model only. At the start of your Command phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, it
can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the start of your next Command phase, the Tactical  doctrine is active for this unit (instead of any other Combat Doctrine you select to be active for your army, and even if there is no Combat Doctrine active for your army).

rules.name: Veteran of Behemoth
rules.text: Adeptus Astartes model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. In addition, while the bearer’s unit is under the effects of the Devastator Doctrine, , you can reroll Advance rolls made for that unit.

rules.name: Grimnar's Mark
rules.text:
Adeptus Astartes Terminator Captain model only. Once per battle round, from the second battle round
onwards, you can target the bearer’s unit with the Rapid Ingress or Heroic Intervention Stratagem for
0CP, and can do so even if you have already targeted a different unit with that Stratagem this turn.


In the Declare Battle Formations step, the bearer can be attached to a Wolf Guard Terminators unit.

rules.name: Howlmaw
rules.text:
Wolf priest model only. At the start of the Fight phase, you can select one enemy unit within 6" of the
bearer. That unit must take a Battle-shock, subtracting 1 from the result.

rules.name: Chariots of the Storm
rules.text: Adeptus Astartes model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three Adeptus Astartes units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

rules.name: Skjald's Foretelling
rules.text: Wolf Guard Battle Leader model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [LANCE] ability.

rules.name: Carmine Reliquary
rules.text:
Chaplain model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Scouts 6" ability. Each time you take a
Battle-shock test for an Adeptus Astartes unit within 6" of the bearer, you can re-roll the result

rules.name: Master of the Red Thirst
rules.text:
Adeptus Astartes model only. Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer can use
this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, models in the bearer’s unit have the Fights
First ability.

rules.name: Sanguinary Tear (Aura)
rules.text:
Adeptus Astartes model only. While a friendly Death Company unit is within 6" of the bearer, add 1 to
the Strength characteristic of weapons equipped by models in that unit.

rules.name: Angel's Fang
rules.text:
Adeptus Astartes model only. Each time the bearer makes a melee attack that targets a Character,
Monster or Vehicle unit, that attack has the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability.

rules.name: Eye of the Primarch
rules.text:
Adeptus Astartes model only. Ranged weapons equipped by the bearer and Battleline models in the
bearer’s unit have the [PRECISION] ability

rules.name: Hero of the Chapter
rules.text: Adeptus Astartes model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, the bearer has the Battleline keyword.

rules.name: Blades of Valour
rules.text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer and Battleline models in the bearer’s unit by 1.

rules.name: Bombast Omnivox
rules.text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Each time you select the bearer’s unit as the target of a Stratagem, roll one D6, adding 1 if the bearer’s unit has the Battleline keyword: on a 4+, you gain 1CP.

rules.name: Laurels of Thunder
rules.text: Adeptus Astartes model only. You can re‑roll Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit in a turn in which it was set up on the battlefield.

rules.name: Orbital Uplink Reliquary
rules.text: Adeptus Astartes model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three Adeptus Astartes units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves if you wish, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

rules.name: Veteran of the Vanguard
rules.text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Scouts 6" ability

rules.name: Dedicated Gunship
rules.text:
Adeptus Astartes Terminator model only. Once per battle, at the end of your opponent’s Fight
phase, if the bearer’s unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, the bearer
can use this Enhancement. If it does, remove the bearer’s unit from the battlefield and place it into
Strategic Reserves.

rules.name: Seals of Reconquest
rules.text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.

rules.name: Avenging Avatar (Aura)
rules.text: Adeptus Astartes model only. In the Battle‑shock step of your opponent’s Command phase, if an enemy unit that is below its Starting Strength is within 9" of the bearer, that enemy unit must take a Battle‑shock test.

rules.name: Scroll of Proclamation
rules.text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Each time the bearer’s unit declares a charge, if one or more targets of that charge are within range of an objective marker, you can re‑roll the Charge roll.

rules.name: Liberatum
rules.text:
Adeptus Astartes model only. Each time the bearer makes an attack that targets an enemy unit, if the
target is within range of an objective marker, you can re‑roll the Hit roll and you can re‑roll the Wound roll.

rules.name: Honour Indefatigable
rules.text: The first time the bearer is destroyed, roll one D6 at the end of the phase. On a 2+, set the bearer back up on the battlefield, as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, with its full wounds remaining.

rules.name: Castellum Omnivox
rules.text:
Each time the bearer’s unit makes a Fall Back move, select one of the following to apply to that unit until the end of the turn: 
- That unit is eligible to perform an Action in a turn in which it Fell Back. 
- That unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

rules.name: Spy-skull Datalink
rules.text: Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

rules.name: Defensive Mastery
rules.text: After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three ^^**Adeptus Astartes**^^ units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

rules.name: Liberator
rules.text:
Adeptus Astartes model only. If you control an objective marker at the end of your Command phase,
and the bearer’s unit (or any Heavy Transport it is embarked within) is within range of that objective
marker, that objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over
that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

rules.name: Tip of the Spear
rules.text:
Adeptus Astartes model only. If the bearer starts the battle embarked within a Transport, that transport
has the Scouts 6" ability

rules.name: Shock Deployment
rules.text: Adeptus Astartes Terminator or Gravis model only. In your Shooting phase, each time the bearer’s unit is selected to shoot, if it disembarked from a Transport this turn, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

rules.name: Armoured Commander
rules.text:
Adeptus Astartes model only. Once per turn, in your Movement phase, the bearer can use this
Enhancement. If it does, select one friendly Adeptus Astartes Transport that is in Strategic Reserves. Until the end of the phase, for the purposes of setting up that Transport on the battlefield, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.

rules.name: Marksman's Honours
rules.text: Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristics of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

rules.name: Purity Seals
rules.text: Models in this unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against Psychic Attacks.

rules.name: Bladesman's Honour
rules.text: Improve the Weapon Skill characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

rules.name: Service Studs
rules.text: At the end of the battle, if this unit is not destroyed, it gains an additional 1XP.

rules.name: Terminator Honours
rules.text: Select one model in this unit (if this unit contains a unit champion, such as a Space Marine Sergeant, you must select that model). Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the selected model's melee weapons and, unless the selected model is a **^^Character^^**, add 1 to its Wounds characteristic.

rules.name: Aquila Imperialis
rules.text: This unit can still be selected as the target of a Stratagem while it is Battle-shocked. In addition, each time an Out of Action test is failed for this unit, you can re-roll that test.

rules.name: Execution Order
rules.text: Each time this unit makes an attack that targets a **^^Character^^** unit, add 1 to the Hit roll.

rules.name: Tactical Repositioning
rules.text: Once per turn, in your opponent's Charge phase, after an enemy unit has selected this unit as a target for its charge but before it makes a Charge move, this unit can choose to retreat. If it does, it can make a Normal move of up to 3". The charging unit can then select new targets for that charge.

rules.name: Death's Own Shadow
rules.text: Each time a ranged attack targets this unit, it has the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

rules.name: Abiding Duty
rules.text: While this unit is Below Half-strength, you can re-roll Battle-shock tests taken for it.

rules.name: Echoes of the Primarch
rules.text: Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, this unit can use this ability. If it does, until the end of the turn, weapons equipped by models in this unit have the **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]** ability.

rules.name: Defenders of Humanity
rules.text: Once per battle, at the start of your Command phase, this unit can use this ability. If it does, until the start of your next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in this unit.

rules.name: Resilient Machine Spirit
rules.text: Add 2 to this model's Wounds characteristic.

rules.name: Bellicose Machine Spirit
rules.text: Each time this model makes a Charge move, select one melee weapon it is equipped with; until the end of the turn, add 2 to the Strength characteristic of that weapon.

rules.name: Focused Machine Spirit
rules.text: This model does not suffer the penalty to its Hit rolls for firing at enemy units that are within Engagement Range of it.

rules.name: Standard of Righteous Hatred
rules.text: **^^Ancient^^** model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit.

rules.name: Vortex Bolt
rules.text: Select one ranged weapon equipped by the bearer; that weapon is now a Crusade Relic. Once per battle, when the bearer shoots with that weapon, you can choose for it to fire a vortex bolt instead of shooting with that weapon normally. If it does, resolve that shooting using the Vortex bolt profile.

rules.name: Relic of the Primarch
rules.text:
Once per battle, in your Command phase, the bearer can unveil the Relic of the Primarch. If it does, until the start of your next Command phase, the bearer has the following ability:

**Relic of the Primarch (Aura)**
- While a friendly **^^Adeptus Astartes^^** unit is within 6" of this model, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit.
- If the bearer is destroyed, after remove it from play set up one new object marker as close as possible to the bearer's last location; this represents the Relic of the Primarch. You immediately gain the Recover the Relic Agenda in addition to any other Agendas being used for the battle.

rules.name: Recover the Relic (Agenda)
rules.text: At  the end of the battle, if you control the Relic of the Primarch objective marker, you can select one unit from your Crusade army that is within 3" of that objective marker; that unit gains 3XP. If you do not control that objective marker at the end of the battle, you lose 10VP (to a minimum of 0).

rules.name: Astartes Teleportation Transponder
rules.text: During the Declare Battle Formations step, if this model is attached a unit, until the end of the battle, that unit has the Deep Strike ability.

rules.name: Adamantine Cuirass
rules.text: Add 1 to the bearer's Toughness and Wounds characteristics.

rules.name: Halo Indomitus
rules.text:
- The bearer has a 4+ invulnerable save.
- The bearer has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.

rules.name: Oath of Vengeance
rules.text: Each time this model makes a melee attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll. If the target of that attack is a **^^Monster^^** or **^^Vehicle^^** unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.

rules.name: Oath of Vengeance
rules.text: Each time this model makes a melee attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll. If the target of that attack is a **^^Monster^^** or **^^Vehicle^^** unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.

rules.name: Master of the Codex
rules.text: Once per battle, after you have selected your Oath of Moment target, select a second enemy unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, that second enemy unit also counts as your Oath of Moment target.

rules.name: Master of Combat
rules.text: Once per battle, in your Command phase, this model can use this ability. If it does, until the end of the turn, add 2 to the Damage characteristic of weapons equipped by this model.

rules.name: Battlefield Chirurgy
rules.text: At the end of the battle, if your Crusade army included this model and it was not destroyed during the battle, you can ignore up to two failed Out of Action tests taken for **^^Infantry^^** units from your Crusade army - those tests are treated as having been passed instead.

rules.name: Selfless Healer
rules.text: **^^Tacticus Apothecary^^** model only. While this model is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

rules.name: Wise Orator
rules.text:
Once per battle, at the start of the battle round, this model can use this ability. If it does, until the end of the turn, this model has the following ability:

**Wise Orator (Aura):** Each time a friendly **^^Adeptus Astartes^^** unit within 6" of this model makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.

rules.name: Mantra of Strength
rules.text: Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, this model can use this ability. If it does, until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Attacks, Strength and Damage characteristics of melee weapons equipped by this model.

rules.name: Liturgy of Resanctification
rules.text: Each time this model uses its Blessing of the Omnissiah ability, the selected **^^Vehicle^^** regains up to D3+3 lost wounds instead of up to D3.

rules.name: Shielded by the Machine God
rules.text: Each time this model uses its Blessing of the Omnissiah ability, until the start of your next Command phase, the selected **^^Vehicle^^** has a 4+ invulnerable save (in addition to that ability's other effects).

rules.name: Roused to Fury
rules.text: Once per battle, at the start of either player's Command phase, this unit can use this ability. If it does, until the end of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of weapons equipped by models in this unit.

rules.name: Ardent Protectors
rules.text: While a **^^Character^^** model is leading this unit, add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of models in that unit.

rules.name: Empyric Castellan
rules.text:
Once per battle, at the start of any phase, this unit can use this ability. If it does, until the start of your next turn, this model has the following ability:

**Empyric Castellan (Aura, Psychic):** While an **^^Adeptus Astartes^^** unit from your army is within 6" of this model, models in that unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

rules.name: Psychic Scourge
rules.text: At the start of your Shooting phase, you can select one enemy unit within 12" of and visible to this model and roll one D6: one a 3-5, that unit suffers D6 mortal wounds; on a 6, that unit suffers D6 mortal wounds and, until the start of your next turn, halve that unit's Move characteristic and halve the result of Charge rolls and Advance rolls made for that unit.

rules.name: Steadfast Example
rules.text:
Once per battle, at the start of your Command phase, this model can use this ability. If it does, until the end of the turn, this model has the following ability:

**Steadfast Example (Aura):** While an **^^Adeptus Astartes^^** unit from your army is within 6" of this model, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit.

rules.name: Pennant of the Fallen
rules.text: While this model is leading a unit, each time a Bodyguard model in that unit is destroyed by a melee attack, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 2+, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking model's unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

rules.name: Silver Talon
rules.text: Each time this model is selected to shoot, you can re-roll one Hit roll or one Wound roll when resolving those attacks.

rules.name: Staunch Hunters
rules.text: At the start of each player's turn, one model in this unit regains 1 lost wound.

rules.name: Lightning Reflexes
rules.text: This model has a 4+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks.

rules.name: Watched Over
rules.text: If this unit is equipped with a Watcher in the Dark, it can use that Watcher in the Dark's ability twice per battle instead of only once.

rules.name: Death On Dark Wings
rules.text: Each time a ranged attack targets this unit, if this unit Advanced in your previous Movement phase, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

rules.name: Inescapable
rules.text: Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack's Ballistic Skill characteristic and/or to the Hit roll.

rules.name: Indomitable Conquerors
rules.text: While this unit is within range of an objective marker, it has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

rules.name: Ever Watchful
rules.text: Once per battle, you can target this unit with the Fire Overwatch or Heroic Intervention Stratagem for 0CP.

rules.name: Shield of Calloson
rules.text: Once per battle, at the start of any phase, the bearer can use this ability. If it does, until the end of the phase, the bearer has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds and a 2+ invulnerable save.

rules.name: Mantle of the Seneschal
rules.text:
- Add 1 to bearer's Move, Toughness and Wounds characteristics and add 1 to the Strength and Attacks characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons.
- While the bearer is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

rules.name: The Raven's Eyes
rules.text: **^^Ravenwing^^** model only. The bearer's unit can ignore any or all modifiers to its Move characteristic and to Advance and Charge rolls made for it.

rules.name: Archeotech Armament
rules.text: Select one ranged weapon equipped by the bearer (excluding a weapon that has been replaced by an Enhancement or upgraded using the Weapons Modifications Battle Honour). That weapon is now a Crusade Relic; improve its Strength, Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics by 1, and that weapon has the **[HAZARDOUS]** ability.

rules.name: Black Pearl Rosarius
rules.text: **^^Chaplain^^** model only. To be eligible for this Crusade Relic, a **^^Chaplain^^** model must have participated in a battle in which you successfully completed the Capture the Fallen Bonus Agenda (see the Hunt the Fallen Oathsworn Campaign). Each time the bearer makes a melee attack that targets a **^^Character^^** unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll. In addition, if that **^^Character^^** unit is a **^^Chaos^^** or **^^Fallen^^** unit, the bearer's melee weapons have the **[LETHAL HITS]** ability for that attack.

rules.name: Master of Watchers
rules.text: At the end of each battle, if your Crusade army for this battle included this model, your Crusade force gains D3 Honour points.

rules.name: Shield of Baal
rules.text: **^^Captain^^** model only. Once per battle, after selecting your Oath of Moment target, you can use this ability. If you do, until the start of your next Command phase, each time this model's unit makes a melee attack that targets your Oath of Moment target, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

rules.name: Sanguinary High Priest
rules.text: **^^Sanguinary Priest^^** model only. Once per battle, when this model's unit is select to fight, you can use this ability. If you do, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapon equipped by models in that unit.

rules.name: Custodian of the Lost
rules.text: **^^Chaplain^^** model only. During the Declare Battle Formations step, if this model is attached to a **^^Death Company^^** unit, select one of the **^^Death Company^^** Battle Scars; until the end of the battle, that unit has that Battle Scar in addition to any others it has.

rules.name: Prophetic Gifts
rules.text: Once per Fight phase, instead of making a Hit roll, Wound roll or saving throw for this model, it can use this ability. If it does, that dice roll is automatically an unmodified 6.

rules.name: Soulwarden
rules.text: Models in this model's unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability and you can target this model's unit with Stratagems even while it is Battle-shocked.

rules.name: Martial Exemplar
rules.text:
At the start of the Fight phase, select one of the following abilities:
- **[LETHAL HITS]**
- **[PRECISION]**
- **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]**
Until the end of the phase, this model's melee weapons have that ability.

rules.name: Skies of Fury
rules.text: Add 1" to the Move characteristic of models in this unit and add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for this unit.

rules.name: Aerial Assault
rules.text: If this unit starts the battle in Strategic Reserves, it can be set up in the Reinforcements step of your first, second or third Movement phase, regardless of any mission rules.

rules.name: The Armoury's Artifice
rules.text: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, if a Critical Wound is scored, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

rules.name: Fury Unbound
rules.text: Each time this unit makes a Charge move, until the end of the turn, each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

rules.name: Selfless Valour
rules.text: Once per battle, you can target this unit with either the Heroic Intervention or Counter-offensive Stratagems for 0CP.

rules.name: Crown Angelic (Aura)
rules.text: In the Battle-shock step of your opponent's Command phase, if an enemy unit that is below its Starting Strength is within 3" of the bearer, that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. If that enemy unit is also Below Half-strength, it must subtract 1 from that test when doing so.

rules.name: Angel's Wing
rules.text: **^^Jump Pack^^** model only. Enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at the bearer's unit. Each time a ranged attack targets the bearer's unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

rules.name: Valour's Edge
rules.text: Improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of the bearer's melee weapons by 2, and those weapons have the **[LETHAL HITS]** ability.

rules.name: Chalice of Baal
rules.text: **^^Sanguinary Priest^^** model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, each time that unit makes a Charge move, until the end of the turn, melee weapons equipped by models in that unit have the **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]** ability.

rules.name: Hood of Baal
rules.text: **^^Psyker^^** model only. Each time the bearer makes a Psychic Attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

rules.name: Acute Senses
rules.text: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the Weapon Skill, Ballistic Skill and/or Hit roll.

rules.name: Thread-cutter
rules.text: The bearer's melee weapons have the **[PRECISION]** ability and each time the bearer makes a melee attack that targets a **^^Character^^** unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

rules.name: Runic Tattoos
rules.text: The bearer has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds and Psychic Attacks. While the bearer is leading a unit, Bodyguard models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability against mortal wounds and Psychic Attacks.

rules.name: Mark of the Wulfen
rules.text: Each time the bearer's unit makes a Charge move, until the end of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic and add 2 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer.

rules.name: Deadly Predators
rules.text: Add 2 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit.

rules.name: Cunning Hunters
rules.text: Each time this unit declares a charge, if it was set up on the battlefield from Strategic Reserves this turn, you can re-roll the Charge roll.

rules.name: Loping Stride
rules.text: Add 1" to the Move characteristic of models in this unit and add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for this unit.

rules.name: Fated Heroes
rules.text: Each time this unit is Marked for Greatness, it gains 5XP instead of 3XP.

rules.name: Counterassault
rules.text: You can target this unit with the Heroic Intervention Stratagem for 0CP, and can do so even if you have already targeted a different unit with that Stratagem this phase.

rules.name: Wyrmsplitter
rules.text: Each time the bearer makes an attack that targets a **^^Monster^^** or **^^Vehicle^^** unit, add 1 to the Wound roll and add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that attack.

rules.name: Belt of Russ
rules.text: The bearer has a 4+ invulnerable save. Once per battle, at the start of any phase, the bearer can use this Crusade Relic: if it does, until the end of the phase, the bearer has a 2+ invulnerable save.

rules.name: Wulfen Stone
rules.text: Add 2 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons. While the bearer is leading a unit, melee weapons equipped by models in that unit have the **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]** ability. If the bearer is a **^^Wolf Guard Battle Leader^^**, while the bearer is leading a unit, melee weapons equipped by models in that unit have the **[SUSTAINED HITS 2]** ability instead.

rules.name: Frost Weapon
rules.text: The bearer's melee weapons have the **[LETHAL HITS]** ability, and improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of those weapons by 1.

rules.name: Wolf-tail Talisman
rules.text: Each time an attack is allocated to the bearer, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

rules.name: Wyrdmaker's Helm
rules.text: Once per battle round, instead of making a Hit roll, a Wound roll or a saving throw for the bearer, the bearer can use this Crusade Relic: if it does, that dice roll is automatically an unmodified 6.

rules.name: Vengeance Before Death
rules.text:
- This model has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.
- This model can never Fall Back.

rules.name: Pack of One
rules.text:
- This model has the Infiltrators and Scouts 6" abilities.
- This model has an Objective Control characteristic of 0.

rules.name: An Honourable End
rules.text:
- This model is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
- Each time this model fails an Out of Action test, subtract an additional 1 from the result.

rules.name: Storm Speaker
rules.text: **^^Psyker^^** model only. Psychic weapons equipped by this model have the **[SUSTAINED HITS 2]** ability.

rules.name: Cunning Trickster (Aura)
rules.text: Each time your opponent targets a unit from their Crusade army with a Stratagem, if that unit is within 12" of this model, increase the cost of that usage of that Stratagem by 1CP.

rules.name: Elder's Wisdom
rules.text: If your Crusade army includes this model, after both players have deployed their armies, you can select this model's unit and/or one other **^^Space Wolves^^** unit from your Crusade army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves if you wish, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

rules.name: Void Sailor
rules.text: At the end of the battle, in the Determine Victor step, if this model is wholly within your opponent's deployment zone, roll one D6, adding 2 to the result if you won the battle: on a 4+, you gain 1RP.

rules.name: Red Axe
rules.text: Each time this model would gain 1XP as a result of Dealers of Death, it gains 2XP instead.

rules.name: Beast Slayer
rules.text: Each time this model makes a melee attack that targets a **^^Monster^^** or **^^Beasts^^** unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

rules.name: Murk Stalker
rules.text: While this model is leading a unit, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that unit's Move characteristic, and you can ignore any or all modifiers to Advance and Charge rolls made for it.

rules.name: Fire Eye
rules.text: In the Select Crusade Blessings step, if your Crusade army includes this model and you are the Underdog, you can select one additional Crusade Blessing.

rules.name: Black Howl
rules.text: At the start of the Fight phase, each enemy unit within 6" of this model must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.

rules.name: Scar Struck
rules.text: Model with one or more Battle Scars only. This model automatically passes Out of Action tests. If this model loses all of its Battle Scars, this Battle Honour is also lost.

rules.name: Savage Orator
rules.text: **^^Wolf Priest^^** model only. While this model is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

rules.name: Death Cheat
rules.text: **^^Wolf Priest^^** model only. At the end of the battle, if your Crusade army included this model and it was not destroyed during the battle, you can re-roll up to two failed Out of Action tests taken for **^^Adeptus Astartes Infantry^^** or *^^Adeptus Astartes Mounted^^** units from your Crusade army.

rules.name: Sceptre of Fallen Empires
rules.text: When selecting Agendas for a battle, if your Crusade force is embarking on an Oathsworn Campaign, you can select on additional **^^Black Templars^^** Agenda for that battle in addition to any others being used in that battle. In addition, if you are using the Oaths of Crusade Bonus Agenda, if you are randomly generating that Bonus Agenda, you re-roll each D6 when determining Deeds, Foes, Passions and Conditions.

rules.name: Penitent's Roar
rules.text: Select one Pistol weapon equipped by the bearer that has the word 'bolt' in its name, e.g. bolt pistol (excluding a weapon that has been upgraded with a Weapon Modification - if you cannot do so, you cannot select this Reclaimed Relic Battle Honour). That weapon is now a Crusade Relic; it has the **[PRECISION]** and **[IGNORES COVER]** abilities and improve its Damage and Armour Penetration characteristics by 1.

rules.name: Crux Obsidian
rules.text: Once per turn, the first time a saving throw is failed for the bearer, change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0.

rules.name: Holy Orb
rules.text: Once per battle, when you target the bearer's unit with the Grenade Stratagem, the bearer can use this Reclaimed Relic. If it does, when resolving that Stratagem, 1 mortal wound is inflicted for each roll of 3+ (instead of each roll of 4+), and after resolving that Stratagem, the enemy unit you selected for that Stratagem must take a Battle-shock test.

rules.name: Fist of Balthus
rules.text: Select one power fist equipped by the bearer (excluding a weapon that has been upgraded with a Weapon Modification - if you cannot do so, you cannot select this Reclaimed Relic Battle Honour). That weapon is now a Crusade Relic. Each time the bearer's unit ends a Charge move, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer and roll one D6: on a 2+, that enemy unit suffers D3+1 mortal wounds.

rules.name: Sigismund's Seal
rules.text: At the start of the battle, select one unit from your opponent's army. Each time a model in the bearer's unit makes a melee attack that targets that unit, that attack has the **[LETHAL HITS]** and **[PRECISION]** abilities. If that unit is destroyed during the battle by the bearer's unit and your Crusade force is embarked on an Oathsworn Campaign, you gain 1 additional Honour point.

rules.name: Sword of the Lost Crusader
rules.text: Select one power weapon or master-crafted power weapon equipped by the bearer (excluding a weapon that has been upgraded with a Weapon Modification - if you cannot do so, you cannot select this Reclaimed Relic Battle Honour). That weapon is now a Crusade Relic. Each time the bearer's unit has fought, select one enemy unit (excluding **^^Vehicles^^**) hit by one or more of the bearer's melee attacks this phase. Until the end of the battle, that enemy unit is set ablaze. While a unit is set ablaze, at the start of each player's Command phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

rules.name: Light of the Emperor's Grace
rules.text: Enemy units that are set up on the battle as Reinforcements cannot be set up within 12" of the bearer. Models in the bearer's unit can ignore any or all modifiers to their Leadership characteristic, and each time the bearer's unit takes a Battle-shock test, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that test.

rules.name: Vortimaran Incensors
rules.text: Models in the bearer's unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.

rules.name: Icon of Heinmann
rules.text: Each time a model in the bearer's unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 5+, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

rules.name: Hands of the Pious
rules.text: Add 1 to Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit. Each time the bearer's unit is selected to fight, if that unit made a Charge move this turn, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit.

rules.name: Beastpyre
rules.text: Select one Torrent weapon equipped by the bearer (excluding a weapon that has been upgraded with a Weapon Modification - if you cannot do so, you cannot select this Reclaimed Relic Battle Honour). That weapon is now a Crusade Relic; it has the **[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]** ability and add 3 to its Attacks characteristic.

rules.name: Master of Arms
rules.text: At the start of the Fight phase, if this model is not leading a unit, until the end of the phase, it has the Fights First ability.

rules.name: Epitome of Piety
rules.text: This model has the Feel No Pain 6+ (this is improved to Feel No Pain 4+ against Psychic Attacks and mortal wounds).

rules.name: Instrument of the Emperor
rules.text: Each time a **^^Character^^** model is destroyed by an attack made by this model, you gain 1CP.

rules.name: Adaptable Executioner
rules.text: Each time this model's unit is selected to fight, select the **[LETHAL HITS]** or **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]** ability. Until the end of the phase, this model's Black Sword has that ability.

rules.name: Inspirational Fighter
rules.text: Each time this model's unit has fought, if one or more **^^Character^^** models were destroyed as a result of attacks made by this model this phase, until the end of the phase, while a friendly **^^Adeptus Astartes^^** unit is within 6" of this model, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit.

rules.name: Front-line Crusader
rules.text: This model has the Scouts 6" ability, and you can re-roll Charge rolls made for this model's unit.

rules.name: Hatred's Disciples
rules.text: Each time this unit ends a Charge move, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of it, then roll one D6 for each model in this unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit: for each 6, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

rules.name: Exceptional Mentors
rules.text: At the end of the battle, if this unit is not destroyed and it contains one or more Neophyte models and one or more other models (excluding **^^Characters^^**), it gains an additional D3XP.

rules.name: Faithful Squires
rules.text: While this unit contains one or more Neophyte models, add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for this unit.

rules.name: Unbreakable Faith
rules.text: Each time an attack targets this unit, if this unit is Below Half-strength, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

rules.name: Litany of Divine Protection
rules.text: While this model is leading a unit, each time a ranged attack targets that unit, that unit has the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

rules.name: Psalm of Remorseless Persecution
rules.text: While this model is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack, if that unit made a Charge move this turn, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

rules.name: Canticle of Rejection
rules.text: While this model is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against Psychic Attacks and mortal wounds.

rules.name: Fires of Devotion
rules.text: While this model is leading a unit, melee weapons equipped by models in that unit have the **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]** ability.

rules.name: Fervent Acclamation
rules.text: Once per battle, in your Command phase, you can select one Vow that is not active for your army. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Vow applies to this model's unit in addition to the Vow selected at the start of the battle.

rules.name: Oath of Glory
rules.text: Each time this model's unit makes a Charge move, until the end of the turn, add 2 to the Attacks characteristics and add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by this model.

rules.name: Strength From Conviction
rules.text: Add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit.

rules.name: Vengeful Retribution
rules.text: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll if this unit is below its Starting Strength, and add 1 to the Wound roll as well if this unit is Below Half-strength.

rules.name: Blades of the Emperor
rules.text: Each time this unit makes a Charge move, until the end of the turn, melee weapons equipped by models in this unit have the **[LETHAL HITS]** ability.

rules.name: Zealous Intervention
rules.text: You can target this unit with the Heroic Intervention Stratagem for 0CP, and can do so even if you have already targeted a different unit with that Stratagem this phase.

rules.name: Relentless Crusaders
rules.text: Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack that targets a unit that is Below Half-strength, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

rules.name: Tännhauser's Bones
rules.text: Each time an attack is allocated to the bearer, change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 1.

rules.name: Ancient Breviary
rules.text: **^^Chaplain^^** model only. You can re-roll Battle-shock tests taken for the bearer's unit. In addition, in the Select Crusade Blessings step, roll one D6, add 2 to the result if you are the Underdog: on a 6+, you can use one additional Crusade Blessing this battle (even if you are not the Underdog).

rules.name: Crusader's Helm
rules.text: The bearer has the Scouts 6" ability. While the bearer is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Scouts 6" ability and that unit can declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

rules.name: Bonds of Duty
rules.text: Select one melee weapon equipped by the bearer (excluding a weapon that has been replaced by an Enhancement or Crusade Relic, or upgraded with any Battle Traits). That weapon is now a Crusade Relic; note this on the bearer's Crusade card. That weapon has the **[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]** ability and improve the Strength, Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics of that weapon by 1. In addition, once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Crusade Relic. If it does, until the end of the phase, models in the bearer's unit have the Fights First ability.

rules.name: Aurillian Shroud
rules.text: Models in the bearer's unit have the Stealth ability.

rules.name: Reliquary Weapon
rules.text: Select one weapon equipped by the bearer (excluding a weapon that has been replaced by an Enhancement or Crusade Relic, or upgraded with any Battle Traits). That weapon is now a Crusade Relic; note this on the bearer's Crusade card. That weapon has the **[LETHAL HITS]** ability and each time an attack is made with that weapon, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

rules.name: Visions of Bloodshed
rules.text:
- Unless this unit starts the battle embarked within a **^^Transport^^**, all **^^Death Company^^** models in this unit have the Scouts 6" ability.
- At the start of every Command phase, this unit must take a Battle-shock test.

rules.name: Inured To Agony
rules.text:
- **^^Death Company^^** models in this unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.
- This unit fails Out of Action tests on rolls of 1-3.

rules.name: Consumed By Rage
rules.text:
- Each time this unit makes a Charge move, until the end of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by **^^Death Company^^** models in this unit.
- This unit can never Fall Back, even within 12" of one or more friendly **^^Chaplains^^**.

rules.name: Precognisance (Psychic)
rules.text: Once per turn, you can re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll, or one saving throw made for this model.

rules.name: Istrouman Cognisance
rules.text:
- Each time you lose a battle while this model is part of your Crusade Army, make a note of your opponent's Faction keyword on this model's Crusade Card. That keyword is one of this model's Learned Foes.
- At the start of the first battle round, if this model is your **^^Warlord^^** and your opponent's Faction keyword matches one of this model's Learned Foes, roll one D6: on a 2+, you gain 1CP.

rules.name: In Preparation, Victory
rules.text: You can target this unit with the Heroic Intervention Stratagem for 0CP, and you can do so even if you have already used that Stratagem on a different unit this phase.

rules.name: Acquirers of Knowledge
rules.text: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, if this unit is within range of an objective marker, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

rules.name: Empyric Tutelage
rules.text: Models in this unit have a 4+ invulnerable save against Psychic attacks.

rules.name: Perceptive Tacticians
rules.text: Each time you select this unit as the target of a Stratagem, roll one D6: on a 5+, you gain 1CP.

rules.name: Amplification (Psychic)
rules.text: In your Command phase, you can select one friendly **^^Adeptus Astartes^^** unit within 18" of this **^^Psyker^^** and roll one D6: on a 1, this **^^Psyker^^**'s unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 2+, until the start of your next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that friendly unit.

rules.name: Mentor
rules.text: If this model is alive at the end of the battle and was part of an Attached unit at the start of the battle, its Bodyguard unit gains D3+1 XP.

rules.name: The Armour Memoriam
rules.text: The bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

rules.name: The Chronicle of Istrouma
rules.text: Once per battle, in your Command phase, if your Crusade force is embarked on an Oathsworn Campaign, you can change your Bonus Oathsworn Agenda for a different one from the table associated with your Oathsworn Campaign. When doing so, you do not lose any Honour points you have already gained from your current Bonus Agenda.

rules.name: The Journal of Artax
rules.text: **^^Psyker^^** model only. Add 1 to the Strength and Damage characteristics of **[PSYCHIC]** weapons the bearer is equipped with.

rules.name: Field Modifications
rules.text: Add 6" to the Range characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit.

rules.name: Aerial Hunter
rules.text: Ranged weapons equipped by this model have the **[ASSAULT]** ability.

rules.name: Evasive Manoeuvres
rules.text: This model has a 5+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks.

rules.name: Point-blank Strike
rules.text: Each time this model makes a ranged attack that targets a unit within 12", you can re-roll the Hit roll.

rules.name: Unhesitating Advance
rules.text: Add 1" to the Move characteristic of models in this unit.

rules.name: Rapid Insertion
rules.text: Models in this unit have the Scouts 6" ability.

rules.name: Tactical Precision
rules.text: Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack that targets a **^^Character^^** unit, on a Critical Hit, that attach has the **[PRECISION]** ability.

rules.name: Superhuman Speed
rules.text: Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase this unit can use this Battle Honour. If it does, until the end of the phase, models in this unit have the Fights First ability.

rules.name: Fighting Retreat
rules.text: This unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

rules.name: Sanctus Gem
rules.text: Once per turn when an attack is allocated to the bearer, it can use this Crusade Relic. If it does, it has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against that attack.

rules.name: Holo-shroud
rules.text: Models in the bearer's unit have the Stealth ability.

rules.name: Heavy Jump Pack and Mk X Gravis Armour
rules.text: **^^Infantry^^** only. Change this model's Move characteristic to 10", its Toughness characteristic to 6 and its Wounds characteristic to 5. Remove the **^^Tacticus^^** keyword, add the **^^Jump Pack^^**, **^^Fly^^** and **^^Gravis^^** keywords, it gains the Deep Strike ability and replace the list of units this model can be attached to: **^^Inceptor Squad^^**.

rules.name: Jump Pack
rules.text: **^^Infantry^^** only. Change this model's Move characteristic to 12", add the **^^Fly^^** and **^^Jump Pack^^** keywords, it gains the Deep Strike ability and replace the list of units this model can be attached to: **^^Assault Intercessors with Jump Packs^^**, **^^Vanguard Veteran Squad with Jump Packs^^**.

rules.name: Mk X Gravis Armour
rules.text: **^^Infantry^^** only. Change this model's Move characteristic to 5", its Toughness characteristic to 6 and its Wounds characteristic to 5. Remove the **^^Tacticus^^** keyword, add the **^^Gravis^^** keyword and replace the list of units this model can be attached to: **^^Gravis^^** (excluding **^^Fly^^**).

rules.name: Mk X Phobos Armour
rules.text: **^^Infantry^^** only. This model gains the Infiltrators and Stealth abilities, remove the **^^Tacticus^^** keyword, add the **^^Phobos^^** keyword, and replace the list of units this model can be attached to: **^^Eliminator Squad^^**, **^^Incursor Squad^^**, **^^Infiltrator Squad^^**, **^^Reiver Squad^^**, **^^Scout Squad^^**.

rules.name: Raider-pattern Bike
rules.text: **^^Infantry^^** only. Change this model's Move characteristic to 12", its Toughness characteristic to 5 and its Wounds characteristic to 5. Remove the **^^Infantry^^** and **^^Tacticus^^** keywords, add the **^^Mounted^^** keyword, it is equipped with 1 twin bolt rifle in addition to the weapons you choose in the next step, and replace the list of units this model can be attached to: **^^Outrider Squad^^**.

rules.name: Terminator Armor
rules.text: **^^Infantry^^** only. Change this model's Move characteristic to 5", its Toughness characteristic to 5, its Save characteristic to 2+, and its Wounds characteristic to 5. Remove the **^^Tacticus^^** keyword, add the **^^Terminator^^** keyword, it has a 4+ invulnerable save, it gains the Deep Strike ability, and replace the list of units this model can be attached to: **^^Terminator Assault Squad^^**, **^^Terminator Squad^^**.

rules.name: Ravenwing Bike
rules.text: **^^Infantry^^** only. Change this model's Move characteristic to 12", its Toughness characteristic to 5 and its Wounds characteristic to 5. Remove the **^^Infantry^^** and **^^Tacticus^^** keywords, add the **^^Mounted^^** keyword, and it has a 5+ invulnerable save, it is equipped with 1 plasma talon or 1 Astartes grenade launcher in addition to the weapons you choose in Step 4, and change the list of units this model can be attached to: **^^Outrider Squad^^**, **^^Ravenwing Black Knights^^**.

rules.name: Death Companion
rules.text: **^^Infantry^^** only. This model gains the Feel No Pain 6+ ability and unless it's unit is within 12" of one or more friendly **^^Chaplain^^** models, it cannot be selected to Fall Back and its Objective Control characteristic is 0. Add the **^^Death Company^^** keyword, and change the list of units this model can be attached to: ^^**Death Company Marines^^**, ^^**Death Company Marines with Bolt Rifles^^**.

rules.name: Death Companion with Jump Pack
rules.text: **^^Infantry^^** only. Change this model's Move characteristic to 12", it gains the Deep Strike and Feel No Pain 6+ abilities, and unless it's unit is within 12" of one or more friendly **^^Chaplain^^** models, it cannot be selected to Fall Back and its Objective Control characteristic is 0. Add the **^^Death Company^^**, **^^Fly^^** and **^^Jump Pack^^** keywords, and change the list of units this model can be attached to: ^^**Death Company Marines with Jump Packs^^**.

rules.name: Hero of the Golden Host
rules.text: **^^Chapter of the Champion^^** only. Change this model's Move characteristic to 12", it gains the Deep Strike ability. Add the **^^Fly^^** and **^^Jump Pack^^** keywords, and change the list of units this model can be attached to: ^^**Sanguinary Guard^^**.

rules.name: Venerable Death Companion
rules.text: **^^Dreadnought^^** only. This model gains the Feel No Pain 6+ ability and unless it's unit is within 12" of one or more friendly **^^Chaplain^^** models, it cannot be selected to Fall Back and its Objective Control characteristic is 0. Add the **^^Death Company^^** keyword.

rules.name: Venerable Librarian
rules.text: **^^Dreadnought^^** only. Add the **^^Psyker^^** keyword, and you can choose one additional ranged weapon for your model to be equipped with, which must be a Psychic weapon.

rules.name: Curse of the Wulfen
rules.text: **^^Champion of the Chapter^^** only. Change this model's Move characteristic to 9", change its Toughness characteristic to 6, and change its Save characteristic to 4+. Remove the **^^Tacticus^^** keyword, add the **^^Wulfen^^** keyword and replace the list of units this model can be attached to: **^^Wulfen^^**, **^^Wulfen with Storm Shields^^**.

rules.name: Fenrisian Terminator Armor
rules.text: **^^Infantry^^** only. Change this model's Move characteristic to 5", its Toughness characteristic to 5, its Save characteristic to 2+, and its Wounds characteristic to 5. Remove the **^^Tacticus^^** keyword, add the **^^Terminator^^** keyword, it has a 4+ invulnerable save, it gains the Deep Strike ability, and replace the list of units this model can be attached to: **^^Wolf Guard Terminators^^**.

rules.name: Thunderwolf Mount
rules.text: **^^Champion of the Chapter^^** only. Change this model's Move characteristic to 12", its Toughness characteristic to 6, and its Wounds characteristic to 7. Remove the **^^Infantry^^** and **^^Tacticus^^** keywords and add the **^^Mounted^^** keyword. It is equipped with 1 teeth and claws in addition to the weapons you choose in Step 4, and replace the list of units this model can be attached to: **^^Thunderwolf Cavalry^^**.

rules.name: Wolf Lord's Chosen
rules.text: **^^Infantry^^** only. Change this model's Move characteristic to 7", and add the list of units this model can be attached to: **^^Blood Claws^^**, **^^Grey Hunters^^**, **^^Wolf Guard Headtakers^^**.

rules.name: Adamantine Will
rules.text: While this model is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against Psychic Attacks

rules.name: Astartes Banner
rules.text: Add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in this unit.

rules.name: Blessing of the Omnissiah
rules.text: In your Command phase, you can select one friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle model within 3" of this model. That model regains up to D3 lost wounds and, until the start of your next Command phase, each time that Vehicle model makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll. Each model can only be selected for this ability once per turn.

rules.name: Litany of Hate
rules.text: Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.

rules.name: Narthecium
rules.text: While this model is leading a unit, in your Command phase, you can return 1 destroyed model (excluding Character models) to that unit.

rules.name: Rites of Battle
rules.text: Once per battle round, one unit from your army with this ability can use it when its unit is targeted with a Stratagem. If it does, reduce the CP cost of that use of that Stratagem by 1CP.

rules.name: Tactical Precision
rules.text: Weapons Equipped by models in this unit have the [Lethal Hits] ability

rules.name: Ravenwing Hunter
rules.text: While this model is leading a unit, that unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced

rules.name: Tortuous Revelation (Psychic)
rules.text: In your Shooting phase, you can select one enemy unit within 18" of this model. That enemy unit must take a Battle-Shock test.

rules.name: Blood Chalice
rules.text: While this model is leading a unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit by 1.

rules.name: Forlorn Hero
rules.text: While this model is leading a unit, unless that unit starts the battle embarked within a Transport, models in that unit have the Scouts 6" ability

rules.name: Storm Shield
rules.text: This model has a 4+ Invulnerable save.

rules.text: Once per phase, when an attack is allocated to this model, and the saving throw is failed, you can change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0.

rules.name: Condemnatory Annihilation
rules.text: Each time this model's unit has fought, if one or more enemy units were destroyed as a result of those attacks, each enemy unit within 6" of this model must take a Battle-Shock test.

rules.name: Inspirational Exemplar
rules.text: While this model is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

rules.name: Remorseless Persecution
rules.text: While this model is leading a unit, that unit is eligible to declare a chare in a turn in which it Advanced.

rules.name: Vehement Aggression
rules.text: While this model is leading a unit, each time that unit is selected to fight, take a Leadership test for that unit: if passed, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll; if failed, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1

rules.name: Vengeful Exhortation
rules.text: While this model is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit is destroyed by a melee attack, if it has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove it from play, the destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

rules.name: Redoubtable Machine Spirit
rules.text:
Adeptus Astartes Vehicle model only. The bearer has a 5+ invulnerable save and, at the end of your
Command phase, the bearer regains 1 lost wound.

rules.name: Gunnery Honours
rules.text:

and one Damage roll for the bearer.

rules.text:

rules.text: While this model is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability

rules.name: Iron Father
rules.text: While this model is within 3" of one or more friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle units, it has the Lone Operative ability.

rules.name: Master of the Forge
rules.text: In your Command phase, select one friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle model within 3" of this model. That model regains up to 3 lost wounds and, until the start of your next Command phase, each time that Vehicle model makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll. rules.name: Leader
rules.text:
This model can be attached to the following units:

■ Aggressor Squad
■ Eradicator Squad
■ Heavy Intercessor Squad

rules.name: Inspiring Commander
rules.text:
If you include this model in your army, until the end of the battle, non-Character models in Heavy
Intercessor Squad units from your army have an Objective Control characteristic of 3 while they are
not Battle-shocked.

rules.name: Cold and Calculating
rules.text:
Each time a model in this model’s unit makes an attack that targets a Monster or Vehicle unit, that
attack has the [LETHAL HITS] ability. Each time a model in this model’s unit makes an attack that targets any other unit, that attack has the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

rules.name: Cerebrex Logic Engine
rules.text:
■ At the start of the Declare Battle Formations step, you can select one Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit from your army. Until the end of the battle, that unit gains the Scouts 6" ability.


■ After both players have deployed their armies, you can select one Adeptus Astartes unit from your army and redeploy it. When doing so, you can set that unit up in Strategic Reserves if you wish, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

rules.name: Leader
rules.text: This model can be attached to the following units: Terminator Assault Squad, Terminator Squad
