rules.name: Rapid Reanimation
rules.text: Once per battle round, you can re-roll the roll for one unit in your Crusade army's Reanimation Protocols ability.

rules.name: Reanimation Master System Ability - Contra-mortis Protocol
rules.text:
If you have access to this Master System ability, you can use it in one of the following ways:

- Once per battle, when a **^^Necrons^^** unit uses its Reanimation Protocols ability, you can use this ability. If you do, that **^^Necrons^^** unit can immediately use its Reanimation Protocols ability a second time.
***OR***
- Once per battle, at the start of your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, until the end of the phase, each time a **^^Necrons^^** unit from your Crusade army uses its Reanimation Protocols ability, add 1 to the result.

rules.name: Resurrection Flux
rules.text: While a unit is Below Half-strength, add 1 to the result of that unit's Reanimation Protocols roll.

rules.name: Reanimation Master System Ability - Contra-mortis Protocol
rules.text:
If you have access to this Master System ability, you can use it in one of the following ways:

- Once per battle, when a **^^Necrons^^** unit uses its Reanimation Protocols ability, you can use this ability. If you do, that **^^Necrons^^** unit can immediately use its Reanimation Protocols ability a second time.
***OR***
- Once per battle, at the start of your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, until the end of the phase, each time a **^^Necrons^^** unit from your Crusade army uses its Reanimation Protocols ability, add 1 to the result.

rules.name: Anastasic Contingency
rules.text: Once per battle, after an enemy unit has caused a unit from your Crusade army to go below its Starting Strength, that unit can use its Reanimation Protocols ability.

rules.name: Reanimation Master System Ability - Contra-mortis Protocol
rules.text:
If you have access to this Master System ability, you can use it in one of the following ways:

- Once per battle, when a **^^Necrons^^** unit uses its Reanimation Protocols ability, you can use this ability. If you do, that **^^Necrons^^** unit can immediately use its Reanimation Protocols ability a second time.
***OR***
- Once per battle, at the start of your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, until the end of the phase, each time a **^^Necrons^^** unit from your Crusade army uses its Reanimation Protocols ability, add 1 to the result.

rules.name: Harmonised Dynastic Hyperdermis
rules.text: At the start of the battle, select one ^^**Character^^** unit and add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of models in that unit until the end of the battle.

rules.name: Command Master System Ability - Directive Override
rules.text:
If you have access to this Master System ability, you can use it in one of the following ways:

- Once per battle, at the start of your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, until the end of the phase, you can re-roll Battle-shock tests taken for **^^Necrons^^** units from your Crusade army.
***OR***
- Once per battle, at the start of your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of **^^Necrons^^** units from your Crusade army.

rules.name: Servile Preservation Protocols
rules.text: At the start of the battle, select one ^^**Character^^** unit. Each time a Bodyguard model in that unit is destroyed by a melee attack, if that model has not fought that phase, roll one D6: on a 3+, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking model's unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

rules.name: Command Master System Ability - Directive Override
rules.text:
If you have access to this Master System ability, you can use it in one of the following ways:

- Once per battle, at the start of your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, until the end of the phase, you can re-roll Battle-shock tests taken for **^^Necrons^^** units from your Crusade army.
***OR***
- Once per battle, at the start of your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of **^^Necrons^^** units from your Crusade army.

rules.name: Remastered Deficiency
rules.text: Once per battle round, you can target a **^^Necrons Character^^** unit from your army with the Command Re-roll Stratagem for 0CP, and can do so even if you have already targeted a different unit with that Stratagem this phase.

rules.name: Command Master System Ability - Directive Override
rules.text:
If you have access to this Master System ability, you can use it in one of the following ways:

- Once per battle, at the start of your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, until the end of the phase, you can re-roll Battle-shock tests taken for **^^Necrons^^** units from your Crusade army.
***OR***
- Once per battle, at the start of your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of **^^Necrons^^** units from your Crusade army.

rules.name: Astromantic Perception Portal
rules.text: Once per turn, select one **^^Necrons^^** unit that was set up on the battlefield using the Deep Strike ability this turn. Until the end of the turn, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

rules.name: Translocation Master System Ability - Special Relocation
rules.text:
If you have access to this Master System ability, you can use it in one of the following ways:

- Once per battle, at the end of your Movement phase, select one **^^Necrons^^** units from your Crusade army and remove it from the battlefield and place it into Reserves. You can select another **^^Necrons Infantry^^** unit from your Crusade army that is in Reserves and set it up as close as possible to where the previous unit was and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units. Until the end of the battle, the unit placed into Reserves has the Deep Strike ability if it did not already have it..
***OR***
- Once per battle, after both players have deployed their armies and determined who has the first turn, you can select up to three **^^Necrons Infantry^^** units from your Crusade army and redeploy all of those units. When doing so, any of those units can be placed into Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

rules.name: Dimensional Catacombs
rules.text: Before the start of the battle, select up to three **^^Necrons Infantry^^** units from your Crusade army. Those units have the Scouts 6" ability, and while using that ability, they can **^^Fly^^**.

rules.name: Translocation Master System Ability - Special Relocation
rules.text:
If you have access to this Master System ability, you can use it in one of the following ways:

- Once per battle, at the end of your Movement phase, select one **^^Necrons^^** units from your Crusade army and remove it from the battlefield and place it into Reserves. You can select another **^^Necrons Infantry^^** unit from your Crusade army that is in Reserves and set it up as close as possible to where the previous unit was and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units. Until the end of the battle, the unit placed into Reserves has the Deep Strike ability if it did not already have it..
***OR***
- Once per battle, after both players have deployed their armies and determined who has the first turn, you can select up to three **^^Necrons Infantry^^** units from your Crusade army and redeploy all of those units. When doing so, any of those units can be placed into Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

rules.name: Scouts
rules.text:
Some units have ‘Scouts x"’ listed in their abilities. If every model in a unit has this ability, then at the start of the first battle round, before the first turn begins, it can make a Normal move of up to x", with the exception that, while making that move, the distance moved by each model in that unit can be greater than that model's Move characteristic, as long as it is not greater than x". 

DEDICATED TRANSPORT models can make use of any Scouts x" ability listed in their abilities, or a Scouts x" ability that a unit that starts the battle embarked within that DEDICATED TRANSPORT  model has (provided only models with this ability are embarked within that Dedicated Transport model), regardless of how that embarked unit gained this ability (e.g. listed in their abilities, conferred by an Enhancement or by an attached Character, etc.). 

A unit that moves using this ability must end that move more than 9" horizontally away from all enemy models. If both players have units that can do this, the player who is taking the first turn moves their units first.

rules.name: Transtemporal Acceleration
rules.text: Once per battle, in your Command phase, select one **^^Necrons^^** unit from your Crusade army. Until the end of the turn, add 2 to Advance and Charge roll made for that unit.

rules.name: Translocation Master System Ability - Special Relocation
rules.text:
If you have access to this Master System ability, you can use it in one of the following ways:

- Once per battle, at the end of your Movement phase, select one **^^Necrons^^** units from your Crusade army and remove it from the battlefield and place it into Reserves. You can select another **^^Necrons Infantry^^** unit from your Crusade army that is in Reserves and set it up as close as possible to where the previous unit was and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units. Until the end of the battle, the unit placed into Reserves has the Deep Strike ability if it did not already have it..
***OR***
- Once per battle, after both players have deployed their armies and determined who has the first turn, you can select up to three **^^Necrons Infantry^^** units from your Crusade army and redeploy all of those units. When doing so, any of those units can be placed into Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

nodes.name: To Raise High the Pennants of Victory

rules.name: To Raise High the Pennants of Victory
rules.text: While this Chivalric Quest is active, at the end of each battle, add 1 to its tally for each objective marker you control. For each of those objective markers that is within your opponent's deployment zone, you gain 1 additional tally mark.

rules.name: To Secure the Realm
rules.text: While this Chivalric Quest is active, at the end of each battle, add 1 to its tally for each of the following conditions you satisfy: one or more **^^Imperial Knights^^** from your Crusade army are within 6" of the centre of the battlefield; no enemy units are within 6" of the centre of the battlefield; one or more **^^Imperial Knights^^** units from your Crusade army are wholly within your opponent's deployment zone.

nodes.name: To Stamp Out the Champions of Dishonour

rules.name: To Stamp Out the Champions of Dishonour
rules.text: While this Chivalric Quest is active, add 1 to its tally each time a **^^Character^^** unit is destroyed by an attack made by an **^^Imperial Knights^^** model from your Crusade force. For each of those destroyed units that was your opponent's **^^Warlord^^**, you gain 1 additional tally mark.

nodes.name: To Strike Down the Unclean Behemoths

rules.name: To Strike Down the Unclean Behemoths
rules.text: While this Chivalric Quest is active, add 1 to its tally each time a **^^Monster^^** or **^^Vehicle^^** unit is destroyed by an attack made by an **^^Imperial Knights^^** model from your Crusade force. For each of those destroyed units that was **^^Titanic^^**, you gain 1 additional tally mark.

rules.name: Blessed Champion
rules.text: After each battle, you can purchase one of the following Requisitions once, and when you do, reduce the cost by 1RP: Renowned Heroes, Ascension to Daemonhood.

rules.name: Circling Rivals
rules.text: After losing a battle, in the Update Crusade Cards step, roll one D6. On a 1, a rival declares a challenge - select one other **^^Heretic Astartes Characters^^** model from your Order of Battle (excluding **^^Epic Heroes^^**) to be the rival (if there a no others, nothing happens). Then, roll one D6 for your **^^Warband Champion^^** and one D6 for that selected **^^Character^^** - the model you roll highest for gain 3XP, and the other model is treated as having failed an Out of Action test.

rules.name: Dark Destiny
rules.text: After each battle, in the Update Crusade Cards step, if your **^^Warband Champion^^** model destroyed one or more enemy units during that battle, roll one D6. On a 6, your **^^Warband Champion^^** gains one Battle Honour of your choice, and change the Leadership characteristic of that model to 5+. Your **^^Warband Champion^^** can gain a maximum of 3 Battle Honours using this Favoured Reward.

rules.name: Failing Champion
rules.text: The RP cost of the following Requisitions is increased by 1RP: Renowned Heroes, Ascension to Daemonhood.

rules.name: Feared and Respected
rules.text: After each battle, you can purchase one of the following Requisitions once, and when you do, reduce the cost by 1RP: Increase Supply Limit, Legendary Veterans, Repair and Recuperate

rules.name: Dwindling Supplies
rules.text: After the battle, in the Update Order of Battle step, roll one D6: on a 1, reduce your Requisition points total by D3; on a 6 you gain 1RP.

rules.name: Unrivalled Raiders
rules.text: After each battle, in the Update Crusade Cards step, you can select one unit from your Crusade army (excluding your **^^Warband Champion^^**) that destroyed one or more enemy units during that battle, then roll one D6. On a 6, that unit gains one Battle Trait or Weapon Enhancement Battle Honour of your choice. No unit from your Crusade force can gain more than 1 Battle Honour using this Favoured Reward.

rules.name: Fading Notoriety
rules.text: The RP cost of the following Requisitions is increased by 1RP: Increase Supply Limit, Legendary Veterans, Repair and Recuperate.

rules.name: Worthy Offerings
rules.text: After each battle, you can purchase one of the following Requisitions once, and when you do, reduce the cost by 1RP: Sacrifice to the Dark Gods, Mortal Empowerment.

rules.name: Anger of the Gods
rules.text: During each battle, each time a unit from your Crusade army makes a Dark Pack, subtract 1 from the resulting Leadership test, and if a unit from your Crusade army destroys one or more enemy units in a phase in which it made a Dark Pact, that unit gains 1XP.

rules.name: Boon of Power
rules.text: After each battle, in the Update Crusade Cards step, you can select one unit from your Crusade army that destroyed one or more enemy units during that battle, then roll one D6. On a 6, that unit gains one Chaos Boon. If that unit is not a **^^Character^^** unit but it contains a Unit Champion, that Unit Champion gains that Chaos Boon, even though normally only **^^Character^^** units can gain Chaos Boons.
